DISP-001.ad: Set the monitor refresh rate to the highest supported value
DISP-001.ne_ise_yarar: Buying a 144 Hz monitor and using it at 60 Hz is the most common mistake. This setting determines how many times per second the screen refreshes.
artilar: Smoother picture and lower display latency
No hardware cost
eksiler: On laptops, a high refresh rate uses slightly more battery
With the wrong cable/port, the high refresh rate option may not appear
dokunmamali: Users who force custom (overclocked) refresh rates the monitor does not support with CRU should be careful
notlar: Each monitor is set to the highest refresh rate it supports at the current resolution; the resolution does not change.
Turning it off only undoes the app's change (returns to the previous Hz value).
DISP-001.varsayilan: Windows usually picks the preferred mode from the EDID; sometimes that is 60 Hz.
DISP-001.gerceklik.aciklama: The refresh rate directly determines display latency and motion clarity.
DISP-001.performans_etkisi.gerekce: It does not change FPS but changes perceived smoothness and display latency; on a high refresh rate monitor stuck at 60 Hz the difference is very clear.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > System > Display > Advanced display > Choose a refresh rate: the highest value (e.g. 144/165/240 Hz).
Make sure the monitor OSD and the cable (DisplayPort or a sufficient HDMI version) support it.
DISP-001.rehber.geri_alma: Choose the previous value in the same menu.
DISP-001.rehber.kontrol: Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name, CurrentRefreshRate  (note: with multiple monitors only one value is returned; for exact information see Settings > System > Display > Advanced display)

DISP-002.ne_ise_yarar: Matches the monitor's refresh to the frame rate the GPU produces. Gives a smooth picture without tearing and without V-Sync stutter. The VRR switch in Windows also makes it work in DX11 games that do not support VRR natively.
artilar: Smoothness when the frame rate fluctuates
Tear-free picture with much lower latency than V-Sync
eksiler: Flicker at low FPS on some panels
If FPS exceeds the refresh rate you leave the VRR range; a limiter is needed (see GPU-NV-05)
dokunmamali: OLED/VA panel users who see flicker with VRR may turn it off in problem games
notlar: This switch only turns on the Windows VRR switch. For G-SYNC/FreeSync it must also be on in the monitor's own menu and in the graphics driver.
DISP-002.varsayilan: Depends on the driver and monitor; the Windows VRR switch is off on many systems.
DISP-002.gerceklik.aciklama: Rests on Blur Busters measurements showing G-SYNC + an FPS cap gives tear-free output with lower latency than V-Sync; but VRR's effect on latency in competitive games has not been shown by a controlled measurement. Turn it on if tearing or stutter bothers you; if you want the lowest latency, try it on and off in your own game.
DISP-002.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Affects smoothness and tearing; it does not raise FPS. Its effect on latency varies by source; there is no controlled measurement.
rehber.adimlar: First turn on Adaptive-Sync/FreeSync in the monitor OSD, then enable it in the GPU driver.
Windows 11: Settings > System > Display > Graphics > Default graphics settings > Variable refresh rate: On (adds 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;' to the DirectXUserGlobalSettings value).
DISP-002.rehber.geri_alma: Turn it off in the same places. For the registry, remove 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;' from the DirectXUserGlobalSettings value.
DISP-002.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences' -Name DirectXUserGlobalSettings -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  (look for 'VRROptimizeEnable=1;' in the value). G-SYNC: NVIDIA Control Panel > Set up G-SYNC. FreeSync: AMD Adrenalin > Display > AMD FreeSync.
DISP-002.gerceklik.celiski: Blur Busters finds G-SYNC + an FPS cap low-latency compared with V-Sync; in competitive FPS games (CS2, Valorant), which lack a controlled measurement, some players keep VRR off. One CS2 measurement (Reflex on) gave 5.44 ms with G-SYNC + V-SYNC off versus 7.88 ms with them on; variables were not separated and it is a single setup.

DISP-003.ne_ise_yarar: Upgrades DirectX 10/11 windowed/borderless games that use the old 'blt' presentation model to the 'flip' model. Latency in windowed mode then gets close to fullscreen, and Auto HDR/VRR can work.
artilar: Lower latency in borderless windowed mode
Keeps the convenience of Alt+Tab
eksiler: Visual glitches or overlay incompatibilities have been reported in a few games; it can be turned off per game
dokunmamali: Specific games that show a black screen/crash with this on (turn it off for that game)
DISP-003.varsayilan: Depends on the version; on some 24H2 systems it is reported to be on by default.
DISP-003.gerceklik.aciklama: A change with a known mechanism, based on Microsoft's DXGI flip model documentation.
DISP-003.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Affects latency and frame presentation consistency more than FPS; applies only to DX10/11 windowed games. DX12/Vulkan already use the flip model.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > System > Display > Graphics > Default graphics settings > Optimizations for windowed games: On.
Per game: Graphics > app > Options.
DISP-003.rehber.geri_alma: Turn the same switch Off or remove 'SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;' from the value.
DISP-003.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences' -Name DirectXUserGlobalSettings -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  (look for 'SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;' in the value)

DISP-004.ne_ise_yarar: Since Windows 10, games that ask for 'exclusive fullscreen' actually run in an optimized borderless window (FSO). This setting forces the game into true exclusive fullscreen.
artilar: Less latency/stutter is reported in some older DX9/DX11 games
Can fix games that misbehave with FSO
eksiler: Alt+Tab gets slower
Overlays and Game Bar do not work in some games
No effect in DX12/Vulkan games
dokunmamali: Applying it globally (system-wide) is unnecessary for games that run fine
notlar: Turns off fullscreen optimizations for all games. Per-game settings will come to the Games menu.
The effect depends on the game; some games show no difference. Takes effect when the game is restarted.
DISP-004.gerceklik.aciklama: The mechanism is real; the benefit depends on the game and driver. The common advice 'turn it off in every game' is not proven.
DISP-004.gerceklik.celiski: Microsoft (DirectX blog) says FSO is equivalent to exclusive fullscreen in performance and latency; in r/GlobalOffensive and similar communities some users report a better feel with it off, but controlled measurements are rare.
DISP-004.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Microsoft states that FSO offers the same latency as exclusive fullscreen; community measurements give conflicting results depending on the game.
rehber.adimlar: Per game (recommended): game exe > Properties > Compatibility > 'Disable fullscreen optimizations'.
By command: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\AppCompatFlags\Layers' -Name '<C:\path\game.exe>' -Value '~ DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE'.
Global (not recommended): under GameConfigStore, GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode=2, GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode=1.
DISP-004.rehber.geri_alma: Untick the compatibility box or run Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\AppCompatFlags\Layers' -Name '<C:\path\game.exe>'. For the global values, GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode=0 and GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode=0.
DISP-004.rehber.kontrol: Per game: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\AppCompatFlags\Layers'  ('DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE' flag on the exe path). Global: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' | Select-Object GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode, GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode

DISP-005.ne_ise_yarar: MPO speeds up desktop composition by handing some screen layers to the GPU's hardware planes. On some driver/monitor combinations it causes flicker, black screens, browser freezes and stutter with multiple monitors. This setting turns MPO off.
artilar: Can fix flicker/stutter/black screen problems with multiple monitors
eksiler: Latency and power use may rise slightly in windowed/borderless games
No benefit on a system without the problem
dokunmamali: Anyone without flicker or freezing problems
Laptop users (MPO saves power during video playback)
notlar: Turn it on only if you have a problem such as flicker, black screen flashes or stutter on a second screen.
DISP-005.gerceklik.aciklama: An official workaround for a specific class of bugs, not a general performance setting. On Windows 11 24H2 this key alone may have no effect.
DISP-005.gerceklik.celiski: There are reports that this key no longer works in Windows 11 24H2 (TechPowerUp, SteamDB MPO notice) and reports that it still works (Microsoft Q&A, Guru3D). MPO has also been reported to come back with newer AMD drivers.
DISP-005.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Fixes a stability problem on affected systems; no effect or slightly negative on unaffected ones.
rehber.adimlar: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Dwm' -Name OverlayTestMode -PropertyType DWord -Value 5 -Force  (NVIDIA's mpo_disable.reg file writes the same value)

DISP-006.ne_ise_yarar: Auto HDR artificially expands DX11/DX12 games made in SDR to HDR.
artilar: More vivid picture on a suitable HDR panel
eksiler: A small GPU cost
Washed-out or wrong colors on weak HDR panels (HDR400)
Screenshot/recording colors break in some games
dokunmamali: Users of monitors without real HDR support or with low brightness
DISP-006.gerceklik.aciklama: A visual feature, not a performance improvement.
DISP-006.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Microsoft states that the GPU cost of Auto HDR is small; it is mainly an image quality setting.
rehber.adimlar: On an HDR monitor: Settings > System > Display > HDR > Use HDR: On; Auto HDR: On/Off.
Calibrate with the Windows HDR Calibration app.
DISP-006.rehber.geri_alma: Turn it off in the same menu.
DISP-006.rehber.kontrol: Settings > System > Display > HDR (Use HDR / Auto HDR). Registry: the 'AutoHDREnable=' field in HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences.
DISP-006.uyumluluk.kaynak_metin.windows: Windows 11 (Auto HDR); HDR also exists in Windows 10

DISP-007.ne_ise_yarar: Windows drops to 60 Hz on the desktop and goes up to a high refresh rate for things like scrolling and inking. Saves battery.
artilar: Fixed high refresh rate: consistent smoothness
eksiler: A fixed high refresh rate uses more battery
dokunmamali: Users who put battery life first
DISP-007.varsayilan: May be Dynamic on laptops that support it.
DISP-007.gerceklik.aciklama: A trade-off between battery and smoothness.
DISP-007.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Games usually trigger the high refresh rate; the difference is mostly in desktop smoothness.
rehber.adimlar: For games choose the fixed highest refresh rate; for battery saving choose 'Dynamic'.
DISP-007.rehber.geri_alma: Go back to 'Dynamic' in the same menu.
DISP-007.rehber.kontrol: Settings > System > Display > Advanced display > is 'Dynamic (… Hz)' selected in the refresh rate list?

DISP-008.ad: Scaling mode: GPU scaling or display scaling
DISP-008.ne_ise_yarar: Determines whether a picture at a non-native resolution is enlarged by the graphics card or by the monitor.
artilar: Consistent results for players who use stretched resolutions
eksiler: Some monitors' scalers give a blurry result
dokunmamali: Players who only play at native resolution (no effect)
DISP-008.gerceklik.aciklama: An image/compatibility setting; there is no consistent evidence for the claim that 'GPU scaling adds latency'.
DISP-008.gerceklik.celiski: Some forum users claim GPU scaling adds one frame of latency; no repeatable measurement supporting this was found.
DISP-008.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The effect depends on the monitor's own scaler; there is no measured, general data on the latency difference of GPU scaling.
rehber.adimlar: Irrelevant if you play at native resolution.
For low resolutions/stretched (e.g. CS2 4:3) choose scaling on the device you want; 'Full screen' mode gives a stretched picture.
DISP-008.rehber.geri_alma: Go back to the previous option.
DISP-008.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Adjust desktop size and position > Perform scaling on: GPU/Display. AMD: Adrenalin > Display > GPU Scaling.
DISP-008.sade_ad: Image scaling: graphics card or monitor

DISP-009.ad: Multiple monitors with different refresh rates and video on a second screen
DISP-009.ne_ise_yarar: In old Windows 10 versions, desktop composition locked to the monitor with the lowest refresh rate and caused stutter. This is largely fixed in newer versions, but playing video on a second screen can still cause in-game stutter on some systems.
artilar: Consistent frame timing
eksiler: Giving up multitasking comfort
dokunmamali: Users who have no problem
DISP-009.gerceklik.aciklama: There are many community reports; Microsoft improved mixed refresh rate support in later Windows 10 versions.
DISP-009.gerceklik.celiski: Some users report the problem is fully fixed; others say it persists, especially with G-SYNC + a windowed game + video on a second screen.
DISP-009.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The problem depends on the driver/system combination; clear stutter on some systems, no effect at all on others.
rehber.adimlar: Do not show constantly moving content (video, animated Discord/browser) on a second screen while gaming; if needed, test turning hardware acceleration in the browser on/off.
DISP-009.rehber.geri_alma: Go back to your previous habits.
DISP-009.rehber.kontrol: Settings > System > Display > Advanced display for each monitor > refresh rate.

SYS-001.ne_ise_yarar: The service that queues print jobs. If you have no printer, turning it off reduces the attack surface (vulnerabilities like PrintNightmare).
artilar: Security: smaller attack surface against print service vulnerabilities
Very little RAM saved
eksiler: You cannot print to any printer, to 'Microsoft Print to PDF' or to PDF/XPS printers
Some programs show errors or do not open when they cannot get a printer list
dokunmamali: Printer users
Anyone who outputs PDF drawings from CAD programs such as AutoCAD/Revit/SolidWorks (plotting uses the print system)
Anyone who uses 'Print to PDF' from Office
Fax/scanner-printer (MFP) users
Corporate/domain computers
SYS-001.gerceklik.aciklama: A real benefit for security; placebo for performance.
SYS-001.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Uses almost no CPU while idle; no effect on FPS is observed.
rehber.adimlar: Stop-Service -Name Spooler -Force; Set-Service -Name Spooler -StartupType Disabled

SYS-002.ne_ise_yarar: Preloads frequently used apps into free RAM to make them open faster.
artilar: On very weak systems with an HDD and 4 GB RAM it can reduce 100% disk usage after startup
eksiler: On systems with an SSD and 8 GB+ RAM, apps open more slowly
Free RAM stays 'unused'; that does not mean performance
dokunmamali: Most users with an SSD and enough RAM
SYS-002.gerceklik.aciklama: Often recommended on r/lowendgaming; no benefit has been shown except with an HDD + low RAM.
SYS-002.gerceklik.celiski: Low-end communities say it fixes the '100% disk' problem; others note that the cache is useful on an SSD.
SYS-002.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Can reduce background disk load on weak HDD systems; no effect or negative on modern systems. Independent measurements are limited.
rehber.adimlar: Stop-Service -Name SysMain -Force; Set-Service -Name SysMain -StartupType Disabled

SYS-003.ne_ise_yarar: Indexes file and email contents for fast searching.
artilar: Removes the disk/CPU load during the first indexing after a fresh install
eksiler: Start menu and Explorer search become very slow
Search in Outlook stops working or slows down
dokunmamali: Outlook users
Office users who use file search
notlar: Search in the Start menu and File Explorer slows down; search in programs like Outlook is affected.
SYS-003.gerceklik.aciklama: Placebo for game FPS; noticeable only during the first indexing period and on very weak HDD systems.
SYS-003.performans_etkisi.gerekce: After indexing completes it uses very few resources while idle; Windows already slows indexing down while there is user activity, such as during a game.
rehber.adimlar: Recommended: Settings > Privacy & security > Searching Windows > reduce the indexed locations or exclude game folders.
Turn off completely: Stop-Service WSearch -Force; Set-Service WSearch -StartupType Disabled

SYS-004.ad: Telemetry: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry (DiagTrack)
artilar: Privacy
Slightly less background network/CPU activity
eksiler: The Windows Insider program requires optional diagnostic data
Some compatibility/troubleshooting features are limited
dokunmamali: Windows Insider users
Managed corporate devices
SYS-004.gerceklik.aciklama: Real for privacy, placebo for FPS. The claim 'disable telemetry and FPS goes up' has no evidence.
SYS-004.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No evidence of a measurable effect on FPS; the real benefit is privacy.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > Privacy & security > Diagnostics & feedback > turn off optional diagnostic data.
Additionally: Set-Service DiagTrack -StartupType Disabled; Stop-Service DiagTrack -Force
SYS-004.rehber.kontrol: Get-Service -Name DiagTrack | Select-Object Status, StartType; Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Name AllowTelemetry -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
SYS-004.uyumluluk.kaynak_metin.windows: Windows 10, Windows 11 (AllowTelemetry=0 is fully effective only on Enterprise/Education)

SYS-005.ne_ise_yarar: Manage Xbox sign-in, cloud saves, Xbox networking and Xbox accessories (XboxGipSvc).
artilar: These services already start manually, so turning them off has no practical benefit
eksiler: Game Pass/Microsoft Store games, cloud saves and Xbox controller/accessory management break
Xbox Game Bar/multiplayer connectivity (Teredo) problems
dokunmamali: Anyone who plays Game Pass or Microsoft Store games
Xbox controller/headset users
AMD Ryzen X3D dual-CCD processor users (Game Bar game detection is needed, see CPU-005)
notlar: The Xbox app, Game Pass games, cloud saves and the Xbox controller (XboxGipSvc) may stop working.
SYS-005.gerceklik.aciklama: Common in debloat lists; no performance benefit, but features are lost.
SYS-005.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Manual-start services do not run unless they are used.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended.
If needed: Set-Service -Name <service> -StartupType Disabled
SYS-005.rehber.kontrol: Get-Service -Name XblAuthManager, XblGameSave, XboxNetApiSvc, XboxGipSvc | Select-Object Name, Status, StartType

SYS-006.ne_ise_yarar: Limits the programs that start automatically with Windows (Discord, Steam, Spotify, OneDrive, manufacturer tools).
artilar: Faster startup
More free RAM and less background CPU use
Fewer overlay/raw input listeners (see INP-011)
eksiler: Some tools (RGB, mouse macros, audio software, VPN) have to be started manually
dokunmamali: Before turning off the audio driver panel, touchpad, security software and hardware utilities, check what they do
SYS-006.gerceklik.aciklama: Programs running in the background consume real resources; one of the most consistent recommendations.
SYS-006.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Clear effect on available memory and background load during games on systems with 8 GB RAM or less; low on powerful systems.
rehber.adimlar: Task Manager > Startup apps > Disable the unnecessary ones.
Or Settings > Apps > Startup.
SYS-006.rehber.geri_alma: Enable them in the same place.
SYS-006.rehber.kontrol: Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand | Select-Object Name, Command, Location; Task Manager > Startup apps (Startup impact column).

SYS-007.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents Microsoft Store apps from running in the background. Does NOT affect classic desktop programs (Discord, Steam).
artilar: Background activity of some Store apps stops
eksiler: No notifications from Store apps (Mail, Calendar, WhatsApp, Phone Link)
The global policy hides the per-app settings
dokunmamali: Anyone who expects notifications from Store apps (WhatsApp, Phone Link)
notlar: This is a system policy: Store apps (e.g. Phone Link, Mail) may stop receiving notifications in the background.
SYS-007.gerceklik.aciklama: The mechanism is real but the effect for gamers is limited; most background load comes from desktop programs.
SYS-007.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Windows already restricts suspended Store apps; no effect on classic desktop programs.
rehber.adimlar: Per app (Windows 11): Settings > Apps > Installed apps > app > Advanced options > Background app permissions: Never.

Global policy: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppPrivacy' -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppPrivacy' -Name LetAppsRunInBackground -PropertyType DWord -Value 2 -Force
SYS-007.sade_ad: Store apps running in the background

SYS-008.ne_ise_yarar: Writes the kernel session to disk at shutdown to speed up the next startup. When turned off, 'Shut down' becomes a real cold shutdown.
artilar: Clean start for driver/hardware problems
Fixes NTFS partitions staying locked when dual booting
Updates are applied more consistently
eksiler: Startup takes a few seconds longer (more on an HDD)
dokunmamali: Users with a slow HDD for whom startup time matters
SYS-008.gerceklik.aciklama: Real for stability/compatibility; no effect on FPS.
SYS-008.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Does not affect game performance; it is about startup time and stability.
rehber.adimlar: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power' -Name HiberbootEnabled -Value 0

SYS-009.ne_ise_yarar: Deletes the hiberfil.sys file (disk space equal to a large part of your RAM size). Also turns off Fast Startup.
artilar: Gigabytes of disk space are freed on small SSDs
eksiler: Hibernation and Fast Startup cannot be used
The session may be lost when a laptop battery reaches a critical level
dokunmamali: Laptop users who use hibernation
notlar: When hibernation is turned off, Fast Startup is disabled automatically too.
SYS-009.gerceklik.aciklama: Real for disk space, placebo for performance. Its effect on game performance is not documented; the hiberfil.sys file takes disk space equal to a percentage of memory.
rehber.adimlar: powercfg /hibernate off

SYS-010.ne_ise_yarar: Collects and sends error reports for crashed apps.
artilar: Report creation after a crash takes less time
eksiler: Crash dumps and troubleshooting information are lost; no reports reach developers
dokunmamali: Users investigating crash problems
SYS-010.gerceklik.aciklama: Common in performance lists, but the service does not run while idle.
SYS-010.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Starts manually; runs only when there is a crash.
rehber.adimlar: Set-Service -Name WerSvc -StartupType Disabled

SYS-011.ne_ise_yarar: Turns off the news/weather panel (WebView2-based), the AI assistant and the screen-snapshot-based 'Recall' feature.
artilar: The RAM used by the Widgets' WebView2 processes is freed
Privacy (Recall)
eksiler: The related features cannot be used
dokunmamali: Anyone who actively uses these features
notlar: This switch only turns off Widgets. Copilot can be uninstalled in Settings > Apps or hidden from the taskbar. Recall (Copilot+ PCs only) is turned off separately as a Windows feature.
SYS-011.varsayilan: Widgets enabled; Recall is optional on Copilot+ PCs (off by default, turned on with user consent).
SYS-011.gerceklik.aciklama: Real for RAM and privacy; low impact on FPS.
SYS-011.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Widget processes can use a few hundred MB of RAM; noticeable on systems with 8 GB RAM, no direct effect on FPS has been shown.
rehber.adimlar: Widgets: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh' -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh' -Name AllowNewsAndInterests -PropertyType DWord -Value 0 -Force.
Recall (Copilot+ PCs only): Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Recall.
Copilot: uninstall it in Settings > Apps or hide it from the taskbar.

SYS-012.ne_ise_yarar: Large file syncs can use disk and upload bandwidth while you play.
artilar: Less network and disk activity while gaming
eksiler: Backups are delayed; unsynced files are at risk
dokunmamali: Anyone who uses OneDrive as a backup (pause instead of turning it off permanently)
SYS-012.varsayilan: Starts at sign-in and syncs continuously.
SYS-012.gerceklik.aciklama: No effect when nothing is syncing.
SYS-012.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only matters while a sync is active (especially higher ping on connections with low upload speed).
rehber.adimlar: OneDrive icon > Settings > Pause syncing (2/8/24 hours) or remove it from startup.
Removing the Documents/Desktop folders from Known Folder Move is a separate step.
SYS-012.rehber.geri_alma: Resume syncing; add it back to startup.
SYS-012.rehber.kontrol: OneDrive icon on the taskbar > status; Get-Process OneDrive -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

SYS-013.ad: Defender exclusions and Dev Drive (instead of turning off Defender)
SYS-013.ne_ise_yarar: Exempts specific folders from real-time scanning; reduces disk/CPU load during game updates, shader cache writes and builds.
artilar: Large game updates/installs can get faster
Security is kept because Defender stays on
eksiler: Malware that gets into an excluded folder is not scanned
dokunmamali: Anyone who installs pirated games or games from untrusted sources
Anyone who wants to exclude all of C:\ or the user folder (never do this)
SYS-013.gerceklik.aciklama: Microsoft officially supports this approach with Dev Drive and performance mode.
SYS-013.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The effect on in-game FPS is usually small; the difference is clearer in loading times and file-heavy operations. The exact figure depends on the game.
rehber.adimlar: Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath 'D:\Games'  (only for game folders installed from sources you trust).
For developers: Settings > System > Storage > Advanced > Disks & volumes > Create Dev Drive.

SYS-014.ad: Windows Update active hours and pausing (instead of turning it off)
SYS-014.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents updates from downloading/installing and restarting automatically while you play.
artilar: No unexpected restarts or background downloads while gaming
Security updates are not given up
eksiler: When the pause ends, the accumulated updates download
SYS-014.gerceklik.aciklama: The safe alternative to turning Windows Update off completely (see PLC-024).
SYS-014.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only matters when an update download/install coincides with a game.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > Windows Update > Advanced options > Active hours: the hours you play.
During tournaments etc., 'Pause updates' (1-5 weeks).
SYS-014.rehber.geri_alma: Set active hours to automatic; resume updates.

SYS-015.ad: Touch Keyboard and Handwriting Panel Service (TabletInputService)
SYS-015.ne_ise_yarar: Touch keyboard, emoji panel (Win+.), handwriting and some IME (input method) functions.
artilar: No clear benefit
eksiler: The emoji panel, touch keyboard and text input in some apps may break
East Asian language input methods may not work
dokunmamali: Users of touchscreen laptops/tablets
Anyone who uses the emoji panel or an IME
notlar: The touch keyboard, handwriting and, in some languages, the emoji/IME panel may stop working.
SYS-015.gerceklik.aciklama: Common in old 'disable services' lists; no measurable benefit.
SYS-015.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Runs on a trigger; no load while idle.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended.
If needed: Set-Service -Name TabletInputService -StartupType Disabled
SYS-015.rehber.kontrol: Get-Service -Name TabletInputService -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Status, StartType

PERF-001.ne_ise_yarar: When a game is detected, prevents Windows Update from installing drivers/showing restart notifications and tries to give the game resource priority.
artilar: Fewer clashes between background updates and the game
Part of the game detection chain on AMD X3D dual-CCD processors
eksiler: In early Windows 10 versions (2017-2020) there were stutter reports in some games; not common in current versions
dokunmamali: Leave it on unless you have confirmed by measurement that Game Mode causes a problem in a specific game
PERF-001.gerceklik.aciklama: The mechanism is real; the effect is small and depends on the situation.
PERF-001.gerceklik.celiski: There are many forum/Reddit posts recommending turning it off on old Windows 10 versions; on current Windows 11 most independent tests show neutral or slightly positive results.
PERF-001.performans_etkisi.gerekce: On powerful systems the difference is usually within measurement error; it may be clearer on weak systems with background load.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > Gaming > Game Mode: On.
Command: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name AutoGameModeEnabled -Value 1 -Type DWord
PERF-001.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name AutoGameModeEnabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  (if there is no value, the default is on)

PERF-002.ad: Turn off Game DVR / background recording (without removing Game Bar)
PERF-002.ne_ise_yarar: Background recording that constantly records the last 30 seconds/minutes uses the GPU encoder and the disk. This setting turns recording off; the Game Bar app stays.
artilar: If background recording is on: the encoding and disk write load goes away
eksiler: 'Record what happened' with Win+Alt+G does not work
With the system policy (AllowGameDVR=0) some Game Bar functions are disabled
dokunmamali: Anyone who records clips with Game Bar
Ryzen 7950X3D/7900X3D/9950X3D/9900X3D users must NOT REMOVE Game Bar (game detection); they may only turn recording off
PERF-002.varsayilan: Background recording off; capture feature on.
PERF-002.gerceklik.aciklama: Continuous recording consumes real resources. But only changing the GameDVR registry values gives no extra benefit when recording is already off.
PERF-002.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Low to medium if background recording is on (encoder and disk load); none if it is already off.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > Gaming > Captures > 'Record what happened' (background recording): Off.

Command: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' -Name GameDVR_Enabled -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR' -Name AppCaptureEnabled -Value 0 -Type DWord.
System-wide policy (optional): HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR AllowGameDVR=0
PERF-002.rehber.geri_alma: GameDVR_Enabled=1 and AppCaptureEnabled=1; delete the policy value: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR' -Name AllowGameDVR

PERF-003.ne_ise_yarar: Makes drivers loaded into the kernel get verified in a hypervisor-protected environment; makes kernel-level attacks harder. The virtualization layer adds a small performance cost.
artilar: FPS gain in some games, especially on older processors (without MBEC support)
Microsoft itself offers turning it off temporarily for gaming as an option
eksiler: Less protection against kernel-level malware and vulnerable drivers
Some corporate/anti-cheat policies check security features
dokunmamali: Work/corporate computers
Users who keep sensitive data, install pirated software or have low security awareness
Windows 10 systems outside ESU (they no longer get security updates anyway)
notlar: Takes effect after the computer restarts. If there is an organization policy or a UEFI lock, Windows may turn this setting back on.
PERF-003.varsayilan: On for most new systems with a clean Windows 11 install.
PERF-003.gerceklik.aciklama: Microsoft's official documentation acknowledges that HVCI and VMP can reduce gaming performance in some scenarios.
PERF-003.gerceklik.celiski: The size of the effect varies a lot from test to test; the difference is smaller on new CPUs.
PERF-003.performans_etkisi.gerekce: A Tom's Hardware test reported losses of up to about 10% in some games; in other tests the difference was a few FPS or within measurement error. The effect depends on the game, CPU generation (MBEC/GMET support) and drivers.
rehber.adimlar: Windows Security > Device security > Core isolation > Memory integrity: Off.
Command: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity' -Name Enabled -Value 0
PERF-003.rehber.geri_alma: On in the same menu or Enabled=1, then restart.
PERF-003.rehber.kontrol: Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceGuard -ClassName Win32_DeviceGuard | Select-Object VirtualizationBasedSecurityStatus, SecurityServicesRunning  (2 in SecurityServicesRunning = HVCI running). Registry: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity Enabled

PERF-004.ad: Turn off Virtual Machine Platform (VMP) / Hyper-V
PERF-004.ne_ise_yarar: Removes the virtualization components that need the hypervisor.
artilar: A small gain in some games when the hypervisor layer is removed (if HVCI is off)
eksiler: WSL2, Docker Desktop, Hyper-V virtual machines, Windows Sandbox and some Android emulators stop working
dokunmamali: Developers who use WSL2/Docker
Users of Hyper-V-based emulators/virtual machines
notlar: WSL2, Docker, the Android subsystem and virtual machine programs need these features.
Memory integrity (HVCI) and some game protection systems may require the hypervisor.
Reading and changing the state can take from a few seconds to a few minutes.
Changes a boot setting (bcdedit). If you use BitLocker, the recovery key may be requested after the change; make sure you have your key (not certain, to be tested).
PERF-004.varsayilan: Depends on the system; on if WSL2/Docker is installed.
PERF-004.gerceklik.aciklama: Mentioned in Microsoft's gaming performance documentation; its effect on its own has not been fully separated. The measurements (2021) were mainly for VBS/HVCI; Virtual Machine Platform alone was not measured. Turning it off stops virtualization features such as WSL2.
PERF-004.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Microsoft says there may be an effect; independent measurements were mostly done together with HVCI, so the effect of VMP alone is uncertain.
rehber.adimlar: Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName VirtualMachinePlatform -NoRestart; Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Microsoft-Hyper-V-All -NoRestart
PERF-004.rehber.kontrol: Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName VirtualMachinePlatform, Microsoft-Hyper-V-All | Select-Object FeatureName, State; bcdedit /enum '{current}' | Select-String hypervisorlaunchtype

PERF-005.ne_ise_yarar: Turns off desktop effects such as window animations, shadows and transparency.
artilar: The desktop feels smoother on old systems or systems with a very weak iGPU
eksiler: Fonts may look broken (if font smoothing is turned off)
Folder thumbnails disappear
dokunmamali: Systems with a modern GPU (no noticeable difference)
notlar: Turns off the same effects as 'Best performance'; screen font smoothing and thumbnails are left ON.
Explorer may need to be restarted for taskbar animations.
PERF-005.gerceklik.aciklama: Real for perceived desktop speed, placebo for game FPS.
PERF-005.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Desktop composition is done by the GPU; no effect in fullscreen games. The benefit is a more responsive desktop feel on very low-end hardware.
rehber.adimlar: SystemPropertiesPerformance.exe > 'Adjust for best performance' (re-ticking screen font smoothing and thumbnails is recommended).
PERF-005.rehber.geri_alma: In the same window, 'Let Windows choose what's best for my computer'.
PERF-005.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VisualEffects' -Name VisualFXSetting -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  (0=let Windows choose, 1=best appearance, 2=best performance, 3=custom)

PERF-006.ad: Per-app GPU selection (laptops with hybrid graphics)
PERF-006.ne_ise_yarar: Ensures the game runs on the dedicated graphics card instead of the integrated one (iGPU).
artilar: A very large FPS gain if the game was accidentally running on the iGPU
eksiler: Choosing high performance for a browser etc. drains the battery quickly
dokunmamali: Desktop systems with a single GPU (no effect)
PERF-006.gerceklik.aciklama: A documented mechanism on Optimus/hybrid graphics systems. On laptops with a MUX switch, 'dGPU only' mode gives extra latency/FPS gains.
PERF-006.performans_etkisi.gerekce: For a game running on the wrong GPU the difference can be several times; no effect if it already runs on the right GPU.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > System > Display > Graphics > app > Options > High performance.
Command: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences' -Name '<C:\path\game.exe>' -Value 'GpuPreference=2;' -PropertyType String -Force
PERF-006.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences'  ('GpuPreference=0/1/2;' for each exe). See which GPU the game runs on in Task Manager > Details > 'GPU engine' column.

PERF-007.ne_ise_yarar: Instead of writing to disk, Windows compresses rarely used pages in RAM. Turning it off ends the CPU time spent on compression, but under memory pressure there is more disk paging.
artilar: On systems with 32 GB+ RAM that never run into memory pressure, the CPU cost of compression goes away
eksiler: On systems with 8-16 GB RAM: more page file use, stutter and longer loading times
dokunmamali: Systems with 16 GB RAM or less
Anyone with the page file on an HDD
notlar: If you have less than 16 GB of RAM, turning it off can increase stutter.
PERF-007.gerceklik.aciklama: The mechanism is real, but whether the effect is positive or negative depends on the amount of RAM.
PERF-007.gerceklik.celiski: Some optimization guides recommend turning it off; Microsoft says it designed this feature for performance.
PERF-007.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No consistent independent measurement; expected to be negative with low RAM and to have no effect with high RAM.
rehber.adimlar: Disable-MMAgent -MemoryCompression

PERF-008.ne_ise_yarar: Windows pushes background processes to efficient cores/lower clocks (EcoQoS). When turned off, background processes also run at full speed.
artilar: Background work such as OBS/streaming/builds is not throttled
eksiler: Battery life and temperature get worse on laptops
No direct benefit for the game, because the foreground game is not throttled anyway
dokunmamali: Laptop users running on battery
PERF-008.gerceklik.aciklama: A real mechanism, but the claim that it 'increases FPS' targets the wrong thing.
PERF-008.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only meaningful for background workloads; no effect is expected for the foreground game. The game in focus already gets high QoS.
rehber.adimlar: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerThrottling' -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerThrottling' -Name PowerThrottlingOff -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force

PERF-009.ne_ise_yarar: A 6-bit value; determines whether time slices are short/long and fixed/variable, and how much of a boost the foreground window gets. 0x26 = short, variable, 3:1 foreground boost.
artilar: In theory, more CPU time for the foreground app
eksiler: A wrong value can starve background audio/streaming processes
The effect is hard to measure on modern multi-core systems
dokunmamali: Streamers/recorders (background processes matter)
PERF-009.varsayilan: 2 (0x2). The 'System Properties > Performance > Advanced > Programs' option corresponds to this value.
PERF-009.gerceklik.aciklama: A real scheduler setting, but on multi-core CPUs most game threads already find a core, so the effect is expected to be small.
PERF-009.gerceklik.celiski: YouTube/Discord optimization packs recommend different 'best' values such as 0x26, 0x28, 0x2A; this inconsistency points to a lack of solid evidence.
PERF-009.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The mechanism is documented; no independent measurement showing a repeatable FPS/latency benefit in games was found.
rehber.adimlar: Recommended: leave it at the default.
To experiment (community value): Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\PriorityControl' -Name Win32PrioritySeparation -Value 0x26
PERF-009.sade_ad: Time share given to the foreground program

PERF-010.ad: Permanent 'High' CPU priority for the game process (IFEO PerfOptions)
PERF-010.ne_ise_yarar: Sets the process priority automatically every time the game starts.
artilar: Priority for the game while heavy work runs in the background (builds, stream encoding)
eksiler: Background audio/Discord/streaming software can be starved
Some anti-cheat systems set the game's priority themselves or dislike IFEO changes
dokunmamali: Anyone who streams with OBS
Games whose anti-cheat locks the process priority
PERF-010.gerceklik.aciklama: The mechanism is real and documented (IFEO); the benefit appears only when the CPU is not enough.
PERF-010.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No effect if the CPU has idle cores; it matters when the CPU is fully loaded.
rehber.adimlar: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\<game.exe>\PerfOptions' -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\<game.exe>\PerfOptions' -Name CpuPriorityClass -PropertyType DWord -Value 3 -Force  (1=Idle, 2=Normal, 3=High, 5=Below normal, 6=Above normal)
PERF-010.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\<game.exe>\PerfOptions' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
PERF-010.sade_ad: Permanent high CPU priority for a game

PERF-011.ad: Turn off in-game overlays (Discord, Steam, NVIDIA, Xbox, RGB software)
PERF-011.ne_ise_yarar: Overlays hook into the game's presentation chain. Several overlays can cause stutter, crashes and anti-cheat problems.
artilar: Consistent frame timing
Fewer compatibility problems
eksiler: In-game chat/FPS counter/friend notifications are lost
dokunmamali: Anyone who actively uses an overlay (keep only one on)
PERF-011.gerceklik.aciklama: Overlay-related stutter and crashes are a common troubleshooting step in communities and game support pages.
PERF-011.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The cost of a single overlay is usually small; several, or buggy versions, can cause stutter.
rehber.adimlar: Turn off the overlays you do not use; test the effect of background apps that use hardware acceleration (Discord, browser).
PERF-011.rehber.geri_alma: Turn them on in the same settings.
PERF-011.rehber.kontrol: Each app's own setting: Discord > Settings > Game Overlay; Steam > Settings > In Game; NVIDIA App > Settings > In-game overlay.

GPU-001.ne_ise_yarar: Moves scheduling of the GPU work queue from the Windows kernel on the CPU to the GPU's own scheduler.
artilar: Required for NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation
Small latency/stutter improvement in some CPU-limited scenarios
eksiler: Stutter reports in some games, VR and capture software (depends on the driver version)
dokunmamali: Anyone using DLSS Frame Generation or similar frame generation should not turn it off
GPU-001.varsayilan: Mostly on in Windows 11 with supporting drivers.
GPU-001.gerceklik.aciklama: An architectural change; the FPS effect is usually small, but features such as frame generation depend on it.
GPU-001.gerceklik.celiski: Some community guides recommend turning it off (stutter), others turning it on (latency); both are based on game-specific observations.
GPU-001.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Microsoft says users may not see a significant difference; independent tests give small positive/negative results depending on the game and driver.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > System > Display > Graphics > Change default graphics settings > Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling.
Command: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name HwSchMode -Value 2 -Type DWord
GPU-001.rehber.geri_alma: Set HwSchMode back to the previous value (1) and restart.
GPU-001.sade_ad: Letting the graphics card schedule its own work (HAGS)

GPU-002.ne_ise_yarar: Shortens the queue of frames the CPU prepares ahead of the GPU. On = at most 1 pre-rendered frame; Ultra = sends the frame just when the GPU needs it.
artilar: Clearly lower input latency in GPU-limited situations
eksiler: No benefit in CPU-limited situations; sometimes average FPS drops slightly or stutter increases
No effect in DX12 and Vulkan games (the game manages the queue)
dokunmamali: No need to bother in games that use Reflex
notlar: The 'Ultra' value in the NVIDIA Control Panel is not in the public NVAPI; Off/On can be chosen here.
If the game supports NVIDIA Reflex, turn Reflex on in the game; this setting then has no effect.
GPU-002.gerceklik.aciklama: NVIDIA's latency guide and independent measurements show lower latency in GPU-limited scenarios.
GPU-002.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Affects latency, not FPS. Meaningful in GPU-limited DX9/DX11 games; low or none in other cases.
rehber.adimlar: If the game supports NVIDIA Reflex: turn Reflex on in the game; this setting then has no effect.
If not, and the GPU is at 95%+ usage: On or Ultra.
GPU-002.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > Global/Program settings > Low Latency Mode. (Programmatic reading: NVIDIA Profile Inspector or NVAPI DRS.)

GPU-003.ad: Power management mode: Prefer maximum performance
GPU-003.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents the GPU from lowering its clock speed at low load.
artilar: In esports games with low GPU usage, frame time spikes caused by clock fluctuation may decrease
eksiler: If applied globally, high power use and heat even on the desktop
Battery and fan noise on laptops
dokunmamali: Laptop users (in the global setting)
Anyone sensitive to electricity use/heat
notlar: In the global setting, 'Maximum performance' means high clocks and power use even when idle; a per-game setting will come to the Games menu.
GPU-003.gerceklik.aciklama: Also mentioned in NVIDIA's latency guide; but the effect is limited to low GPU load scenarios. An independent comparison found small, inconsistent FPS changes and a clear rise in idle power draw; the authors advise keeping the default unless you have trouble reaching target clock speeds.
GPU-003.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Under high GPU load the GPU already runs at maximum clock; the difference is in frame time consistency in low-load games.
rehber.adimlar: In the Program settings tab, 'Prefer maximum performance' only for games.
Applying it globally is not recommended.
GPU-003.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > Power management mode.

GPU-004.ne_ise_yarar: Saves memory bandwidth by making small quality shortcuts in texture filtering.
artilar: A small FPS gain on very weak/old GPUs
eksiler: Shimmering and blur on floors and distant surfaces
dokunmamali: Modern GPUs (the difference is within measurement error, the picture gets worse)
GPU-004.gerceklik.aciklama: A real quality/performance trade-off, but the gain is very small.
GPU-004.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The cost of texture filtering is very small on modern GPUs.
rehber.adimlar: Choose 'High performance' (anisotropic sample optimization and trilinear optimization are turned on too).
GPU-004.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > Texture filtering - Quality.

GPU-005.ne_ise_yarar: Stores compiled shaders on disk so the same shaders are not compiled again when the game is reopened.
artilar: Fewer compile stutters caused by cache overflow for people who play many large games
eksiler: Uses more disk space
dokunmamali: Anyone with very limited disk space
notlar: Only 'Driver default' and 'Unlimited' are offered: the unit of the other sizes is not stated in NVIDIA's documentation.
GPU-005.gerceklik.aciklama: The mechanism is real; the benefit appears only when the default cache fills up.
GPU-005.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Does not change average FPS; can improve stutter (1% lows) on systems where the cache overflows.
rehber.adimlar: If there is enough disk space: 10 GB, 100 GB or Unlimited.
GPU-005.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > Shader Cache Size. Cache: %LOCALAPPDATA%\NVIDIA\DXCache and GLCache.

GPU-006.ad: G-SYNC + V-Sync (in the driver) + FPS cap combination
GPU-006.ne_ise_yarar: Guarantees staying within the G-SYNC range; gives a tear-free picture without V-Sync latency. Driver V-Sync together with G-SYNC only prevents tearing during frame time fluctuations.
artilar: The lowest latency for a tear-free picture (Blur Busters measurements)
eksiler: FPS cannot go above the refresh rate (competitive players may accept tearing and prefer uncapped FPS)
dokunmamali: Anyone without a G-SYNC/VRR monitor (needs a different strategy)
notlar: Only the driver's Vertical sync is chosen here. Turn on G-SYNC in the NVIDIA Control Panel and the FPS cap with the 'Max frame rate' setting.
GPU-006.varsayilan: V-Sync: Use the 3D application setting; FPS cap: Off.
GPU-006.gerceklik.aciklama: Measured with a high-speed camera in the Blur Busters G-SYNC 101 series.
GPU-006.gerceklik.celiski: Some competitive players argue that uncapped FPS + V-Sync off gives lower latency; this is true at FPS far above the refresh rate, at the cost of tearing.
GPU-006.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Caps FPS but improves latency and frame consistency; the latency difference compared to traditional V-Sync is large.
rehber.adimlar: G-SYNC: On.
NVCP Vertical sync: On.
In-game V-Sync: Off.
FPS cap: a few FPS below the refresh rate (e.g. ~138-141 for 144 Hz) — preferably the in-game limiter or Reflex (Reflex sets a cap automatically when V-Sync is on).
GPU-006.rehber.geri_alma: Restore the settings to their previous state.
GPU-006.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Set up G-SYNC; Manage 3D settings > Vertical sync and Max Frame Rate.
GPU-006.sade_ad: G-SYNC, V-Sync and FPS limit together

GPU-007.ne_ise_yarar: Caps FPS at a fixed value. Gives consistent frame times, can reduce latency by keeping the GPU from hitting 100%, and lowers heat and power use.
artilar: Consistent frame times
Staying within the VRR range
Less heat/fan noise on laptops
eksiler: Usually slightly higher latency than an in-game limiter
notlar: With G-SYNC the recommended value is 3 below the monitor refresh rate (e.g. 141 for 144 Hz).
GPU-007.gerceklik.aciklama: Capping FPS lowers latency by draining the render queue when GPU-limited (NVIDIA and Blur Busters).
GPU-007.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Lowers FPS but can improve consistency and latency; the effect depends on the chosen value.
rehber.adimlar: Order of preference: in-game limiter / Reflex > driver limiter > RTSS.
In the driver: On > value.
GPU-007.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > Max Frame Rate.
GPU-007.sade_ad: Setting an FPS limit in the driver

GPU-008.ne_ise_yarar: Lets the driver split its workload into separate threads on multi-core CPUs.
artilar: FPS gain in some older CPU-limited games
eksiler: Stutter or drops in some games
dokunmamali: Anyone without a problem
GPU-008.gerceklik.aciklama: The driver default already decides based on game profiles.
GPU-008.gerceklik.celiski: Community guides give opposite advice for 'On' and 'Off'.
GPU-008.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Positive or negative depending on the game; there is no general rule.
rehber.adimlar: Leave it at the default (Auto); only if a specific game (usually old OpenGL/DX9) has a problem, try On/Off per program.
GPU-008.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > Threaded optimization.

GPU-009.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents old games that change resolution in exclusive fullscreen from dropping to 60 Hz.
artilar: Guaranteed high refresh rate in old games
eksiler: Rarely a problem in games locked to a specific refresh rate
GPU-009.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only effective in old/exclusive fullscreen games that drop to 60 Hz; in that case the difference is large.
rehber.adimlar: Choose 'Highest available'.
GPU-009.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > Preferred refresh rate (shown on G-SYNC monitors).

GPU-010.ne_ise_yarar: Dynamically synchronizes the render queue between the game engine and the driver; the advanced, in-game version of Low Latency Mode. Boost keeps GPU clocks high in CPU-limited situations.
artilar: The most effective latency reduction method in supported games
eksiler: Boost increases power use
FPS may drop slightly in some games
GPU-010.gerceklik.aciklama: NVIDIA and independent (LDAT) measurements confirm lower latency.
GPU-010.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Clearly lowers system latency in GPU-limited scenarios; does not increase FPS.
rehber.adimlar: On; 'On + Boost' if not GPU-limited and power does not matter.
GPU-010.rehber.kontrol: In-game graphics settings > NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency.

GPU-011.ad: Instant Replay and RTX Video Super Resolution
GPU-011.ne_ise_yarar: Instant Replay continuously encodes with NVENC and writes to disk. RTX VSR upscales browser videos with the GPU's Tensor cores.
artilar: The background encoding and video upscaling load goes away
eksiler: Clip recording/video quality features are lost
dokunmamali: Anyone who actively records clips
GPU-011.varsayilan: Instant Replay off; RTX VSR off after install (the user turns it on).
GPU-011.gerceklik.aciklama: Removes background workload; the effect is small.
GPU-011.performans_etkisi.gerekce: NVENC is a separate hardware unit; the cost is low but not zero. RTX VSR uses clear GPU power at high quality levels.
rehber.adimlar: If you do not use it, turn off Instant Replay.
If you watch video on a second screen while gaming, turn off RTX Video Super Resolution/HDR or lower its quality level.
GPU-011.rehber.geri_alma: Turn it on in the same place.
GPU-011.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA App > Recording > Instant Replay; NVIDIA Control Panel > Video > Adjust video image settings > RTX video enhancement.

GPU-012.ne_ise_yarar: DLDSR renders at a higher resolution and scales down to the screen (quality up, FPS down). NIS upscales from a lower resolution (FPS up, quality down).
artilar: DLDSR: sharper, less edge shimmer
NIS: FPS gain in games without DLSS/FSR
eksiler: DLDSR: clear FPS loss
NIS: blur/oversharpening
dokunmamali: In games with DLSS/FSR, use the game's own upscaler instead of NIS
GPU-012.gerceklik.aciklama: Render resolution is the biggest factor for FPS in GPU-limited games.
GPU-012.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Changes the render resolution, so it affects FPS directly and clearly (the direction depends on the choice).
rehber.adimlar: For quality (if you have spare GPU power): DLDSR 1.78x/2.25x.
For performance: if the game has no DLSS/FSR, NIS or a lower resolution + sharpening.
GPU-012.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > DSR - Factors; Image Scaling.

GPU-013.ne_ise_yarar: Reduces input latency by limiting how far the CPU gets ahead of the GPU (the counterpart of NVIDIA Low Latency Mode/Reflex).
artilar: Lower latency when GPU-limited
eksiler: Little benefit when CPU-limited; rarely an FPS drop
dokunmamali: 'Anti-Lag+', briefly released in 2023, caused VAC bans in CS2 because it interfered with game DLLs; AMD withdrew that version. In competitive games avoid driver-side features that inject into the game; use in-game Anti-Lag 2.
GPU-013.gerceklik.celiski: Because of the Anti-Lag+ (2023) VAC ban case, a rumor spread that 'AMD latency features cause bans'; it only applied to the withdrawn Anti-Lag+.
GPU-013.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Affects latency; meaningful in GPU-limited scenarios.
rehber.adimlar: Anti-Lag in the driver: On (in GPU-limited games).
If the game supports Anti-Lag 2, turn it on in the game.
GPU-013.rehber.kontrol: AMD Software: Adrenalin > Gaming > Graphics > Radeon Anti-Lag. Anti-Lag 2: in-game setting.
notlar: This is the driver's global Anti-Lag. If the game supports Anti-Lag 2, turn that on in the game.

GPU-014.ne_ise_yarar: Lowers FPS when there is no mouse/keyboard movement and raises it when there is. With a fixed min=max it becomes a simple FPS limiter.
artilar: Less power, heat and fan noise on laptops and quiet systems
eksiler: FPS ramping up when movement starts can feel like latency/stutter
dokunmamali: Competitive FPS players (in dynamic mode)
GPU-014.gerceklik.aciklama: Designed for power saving; it is not a performance feature.
GPU-014.performans_etkisi.gerekce: A power-saving feature that deliberately lowers FPS.
rehber.adimlar: For power/heat saving: On, and set min/max FPS.
In competitive games: Off.
GPU-014.rehber.kontrol: AMD Software: Adrenalin > Gaming > Graphics > Radeon Chill.
notlar: Here it can only be turned on or off; the minimum / maximum FPS values are set in AMD Software.

GPU-015.ad: Radeon Boost, Enhanced Sync and AFMF (driver frame generation)
GPU-015.ne_ise_yarar: Features that trade image quality or latency for higher FPS or smoothness.
artilar: Boost: higher FPS during movement
AFMF: perceived smoothness at low FPS
eksiler: Boost: blur during movement
Enhanced Sync: stutter reports on some systems
AFMF: input latency increases, real FPS does not
dokunmamali: Competitive players should not use AFMF
GPU-015.gerceklik.aciklama: Real features, but a trade-off, not 'free FPS'.
GPU-015.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Can increase displayed FPS, but at the cost of latency/quality.
rehber.adimlar: Boost: lowers resolution dynamically during fast movement (in supported games).
Enhanced Sync: reduces tearing outside the FreeSync range.
AFMF: driver-level frame generation.
Test each of them per game.
notlar: AFMF (driver frame generation) and per-game settings are set in AMD Software.

GPU-016.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents an idle (usually secondary) GPU from entering a deep sleep state.
artilar: Fixes stability/wake-up problems on old CrossFire systems and with some overclocking tools
eksiler: Higher idle power use
No benefit on modern single-GPU systems
A driver update may reset the value
dokunmamali: Single-GPU systems
Laptops
GPU-016.gerceklik.aciklama: A real fix for old multi-GPU problems; placebo as a general performance setting.
GPU-016.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No effect on game performance with a single GPU; it is for multi-GPU/OC stability.
rehber.adimlar: In the AMD GPU's subkey (e.g. 0000): Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}\<0000>' -Name EnableUlps -Value 0
GPU-016.rehber.kontrol: Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Get-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name EnableUlps -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } | Select-Object PSChildName, EnableUlps
GPU-016.sade_ad: Turning off the AMD card's deep power-saving sleep

GPU-017.ne_ise_yarar: Lets the CPU access all of the GPU memory at once.
artilar: FPS gain in some games; nearly required for Intel Arc
eksiler: A small drop in some games (which is why NVIDIA uses a per-game whitelist)
Turning off CSM breaks booting on old MBR installs (run MBR2GPT first)
dokunmamali: Installs with MBR/Legacy boot must not turn off CSM without converting first
GPU-017.varsayilan: Depends on the motherboard; off by default on many new motherboards.
GPU-017.gerceklik.aciklama: Documented by GPU manufacturers and confirmed by independent tests.
GPU-017.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Varies by game; high on Intel Arc, between none and low-medium on NVIDIA/AMD depending on the game.
rehber.adimlar: BIOS: CSM off (UEFI boot), 'Above 4G Decoding' on, 'Re-Size BAR Support' on.
Then confirm in the driver that it is enabled.
GPU-017.rehber.geri_alma: Turn off Re-Size BAR in the BIOS.
GPU-017.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > System Information > Resizable BAR: Yes/No. AMD Adrenalin > Performance > Hardware > Smart Access Memory. GPU-Z also shows it.

GPU-018.ne_ise_yarar: Makes the device deliver interrupts with memory writes instead of a shared (line-based) line; reduces interrupt sharing and latency.
artilar: DPC/interrupt latency may drop on devices that use a shared IRQ
eksiler: Turning it on for a device that does not support MSI can cause a blue screen/failure to boot
A driver update may reset the value
dokunmamali: Devices whose driver already uses MSI (no extra effect)
Users unfamiliar with the registry and Safe Mode recovery
GPU-018.varsayilan: Set by the driver INF file; many modern GPU/NVMe/NIC drivers already use MSI.
GPU-018.gerceklik.aciklama: Microsoft describes MSI as a documented mechanism; a benefit is only expected on devices running line-based. On one test system, turning MSI on did not change frame times; the Windows 11 drivers there had already put the GPU, USB, NVMe and network devices in MSI/MSI-X mode.
GPU-018.gerceklik.celiski: In the Blur Busters/Guru3D community some report improvements with 'MSI Utility' and others see no difference.
GPU-018.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No effect on devices that already use MSI; latency improvements on old devices left in line-based mode come from community reports.
rehber.adimlar: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\PCI\<device-id>\<instance>\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties' -Name MSISupported -Value 1 -Type DWord  (create the key first if it does not exist)
GPU-018.rehber.geri_alma: MSISupported=0 or delete the value; restart. If it does not boot, undo it from Safe Mode.
GPU-018.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\PCI\<device-id>\<instance>\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties' -Name MSISupported -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue. Device Manager > View > Resources by connection > if the IRQ value is negative, MSI is used.

GPU-019.ad: Clean driver install (DDU) and an up-to-date driver
GPU-019.ne_ise_yarar: Contains optimizations and bug fixes for new games; DDU removes leftovers when changing GPU brands and after broken installs.
artilar: Clear improvements in new games
Fixes crashes/black screens caused by leftovers
eksiler: New drivers sometimes bring regressions
dokunmamali: Workstations that run stably without problems (prefer Studio drivers)
GPU-019.varsayilan: Windows Update may install a generic driver.
GPU-019.gerceklik.aciklama: An up-to-date driver gives a real benefit; the habit of 'DDU on every update' is unnecessary. DDU is not a performance tool; it is a tool for cleaning up driver problems.
GPU-019.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Driver optimizations can make a big difference in new games; usually no difference in old games. DDU itself does not increase FPS.
rehber.adimlar: Download the current driver from the manufacturer.
If there is a problem, uninstall with Display Driver Uninstaller (DDU) in Safe Mode and install the new driver while disconnected from the internet.
GPU-019.rehber.kontrol: Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name, DriverVersion, DriverDate
notlar: DDU and NVCleanstall are not bundled with the program: download them from their official pages and put them in the tools folder. Neither has a reliable command-line mode, so the app only opens the tool; you do the steps inside the tool.
DDU is not needed for every driver update; use it when changing GPU brand or after a broken install.

CPU-001.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents Windows from 'parking' idle cores to sleep; all cores are always ready to take work.
artilar: Stutter caused by core wake-up latency may decrease in some old games and with sudden load changes
eksiler: Higher idle power use and heat
On AMD Ryzen 7950X3D/7900X3D/9950X3D/9900X3D the mechanism that sends the game to the right (V-Cache) CCD relies on core parking; turning it off CAN LOWER performance
dokunmamali: Dual-CCD Ryzen X3D users
Laptop users (battery and heat)
CPU-001.varsayilan: A low percentage in the Balanced plan (parking enabled); 100 in the High Performance plan.
CPU-001.gerceklik.aciklama: It was a real problem in the Windows 7 era (especially AMD FX/early Ryzen); today the benefit is uncertain and it can be harmful on X3D. No difference is expected on single-CCD processors; on dual-CCD X3D parts it can hurt.
CPU-001.gerceklik.celiski: r/lowendgaming and old guides recommend 'unpark' tools; AMD X3D guides say parking is part of how it works.
CPU-001.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Independent tests with the modern Windows 10/11 scheduler have not shown a consistent benefit; the Windows 7-era problems are largely behind us.
rehber.adimlar: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR CPMINCORES 100; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
CPU-001.rehber.geri_alma: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR CPMINCORES <previous value, usually 5-10 in the Balanced plan>; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT  (or: powercfg -restoredefaultschemes — deletes ALL custom plans)
CPU-001.rehber.kontrol: powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR CPMINCORES  (if hidden, first: powercfg -attributes SUB_PROCESSOR CPMINCORES -ATTRIB_HIDE)

CPU-002.ne_ise_yarar: Sets the lowest performance state the processor can drop to when idle.
artilar: Less clock ramp-up delay
eksiler: Higher idle power and heat
On modern CPUs (Intel Speed Shift / AMD CPPC) clock transitions already take microseconds
dokunmamali: Laptop users
CPU-002.gerceklik.aciklama: It mattered more on older CPUs (before Speed Shift). The mechanism is described in Microsoft's server documentation (100 is suggested for very low latency); no measurement of its effect on game latency was found.
CPU-002.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Boosting is very fast with hardware-controlled P-states; under game load the CPU is already at a high clock.
rehber.adimlar: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMIN 100; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
CPU-002.rehber.geri_alma: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMIN 5; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT  (the Balanced plan default is usually 5%)

CPU-003.ad: Processor performance boost mode (PERFBOOSTMODE) – laptop heat control
CPU-003.ne_ise_yarar: Determines Turbo Boost/Precision Boost behavior. 0 (Disabled) turns turbo off completely.
artilar: On a laptop, limiting turbo greatly lowers temperature and fan noise and can reduce sudden FPS drops caused by thermal throttling
eksiler: With turbo off, a clear FPS loss in CPU-limited games
dokunmamali: Desktop users with good cooling (do not lower the value)
notlar: This is an experimental setting: turn it on if the laptop gets very hot, turn it off if performance drops.
CPU-003.gerceklik.aciklama: A documented power setting; common in laptop communities and the effect is measurable (temperature).
CPU-003.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Lowering it on a desktop reduces performance; on a laptop that hits its thermal limit it can improve consistency.
rehber.adimlar: Desktop: leave it at 2 (Aggressive).

To try on a hot laptop: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PERFBOOSTMODE 4; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT  (0=Disabled, 1=Enabled, 2=Aggressive, 3=Efficient Enabled, 4=Efficient Aggressive)
CPU-003.rehber.geri_alma: Go back to the previous value (usually 2) and run powercfg -attributes SUB_PROCESSOR PERFBOOSTMODE +ATTRIB_HIDE
CPU-003.rehber.kontrol: powercfg -attributes SUB_PROCESSOR PERFBOOSTMODE -ATTRIB_HIDE; powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PERFBOOSTMODE

CPU-004.ne_ise_yarar: Turns off software protections against processor side-channel vulnerabilities.
artilar: A measurable gain in disk I/O- and system-call-heavy work on old Intel CPUs (roughly before 8th gen)
eksiler: Makes the PC open to memory-reading attacks through the browser and local malicious code
On new CPUs the mitigations are in hardware, so the gain is negligible
dokunmamali: Any computer used for browsing, shared or used for work
Owners of new-generation CPUs (no benefit)
notlar: Takes effect after the computer restarts.
Lowers security: malicious code in the browser or on the PC can read kernel memory.
On Windows 10 (support ended 14 October 2025) turning this off is riskier than on Windows 11.
Not applied if a restore point cannot be created. On AMD and new Intel CPUs the gain is negligible.

If Windows does not start: in Safe Mode, in an administrator command prompt run reg delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v FeatureSettingsOverride /f and the same for FeatureSettingsOverrideMask, then restart; or use System Restore in the recovery environment to go back to the point before this change.
CPU-004.varsayilan: No value (mitigations enabled depending on the CPU).
CPU-004.gerceklik.aciklama: The effect is real but the security cost is high; Microsoft documents it only for specific scenarios.
CPU-004.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Usually low in games; clearer with an old Intel CPU + heavy I/O. Very low on new CPUs.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended.
According to Microsoft KB4073119: FeatureSettingsOverride=3 and FeatureSettingsOverrideMask=3 (DWORD) — turns off the Spectre v2 and Meltdown mitigations.
CPU-004.rehber.geri_alma: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' -Name FeatureSettingsOverride, FeatureSettingsOverrideMask; restart
CPU-004.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' | Select-Object FeatureSettingsOverride, FeatureSettingsOverrideMask  (detailed status with Microsoft's SpeculationControl PowerShell module: Get-SpeculationControlSettings)

CPU-005.ad: AMD Ryzen X3D (dual CCD): Game Bar + AMD chipset driver + Balanced plan
CPU-005.ne_ise_yarar: On the 7950X3D/7900X3D/9950X3D/9900X3D only one of the two CCDs has the extra cache. When a game is detected (through Game Bar) the other CCD is parked and the game runs on the V-Cache cores.
artilar: The game runs on the right cores: a clear FPS and 1% low difference depending on the game
eksiler: Games that are not detected may run on the wrong CCD (mark them in Game Bar with 'Remember this is a game')
dokunmamali: On these processors, debloat scripts that remove Game Bar, 'Ultimate/High Performance' plans and tools that turn off core parking break the mechanism
CPU-005.gerceklik.aciklama: AMD and independent reviews (Notebookcheck, TheFPSReview) confirm the dependency on Game Bar and the driver.
CPU-005.gerceklik.celiski: Some reviews say the driver does the parking, others say Windows power management does; the division of work is not entirely clear, but there is agreement that the components are needed.
CPU-005.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Scheduling on the wrong CCD can cause a serious performance loss depending on the game; the right configuration prevents this.
rehber.adimlar: Install the current AMD chipset driver (including the 3D V-Cache Performance Optimizer driver).
Keep Xbox Game Bar installed and up to date.
Use the Balanced power plan.
In the BIOS: CPPC and CPPC Preferred Cores: Auto/Enabled.
CPU-005.rehber.kontrol: Get-AppxPackage Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay | Select-Object Version; Get-Service -Name amd3dvcacheSvc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; powercfg /getactivescheme

CPU-006.ad: Windows 11 and E-core handling on Intel hybrid (P/E core) processors
CPU-006.ne_ise_yarar: Making sure game threads run on the performance cores on 12th gen and later Intel processors.
artilar: With Windows 11 + current games, scheduling is usually correct
eksiler: Turning off E-cores causes a serious performance loss in multi-core work (builds, rendering, streaming)
dokunmamali: Users who have no problem
CPU-006.gerceklik.aciklama: Denuvo DRM and scheduling problems were real at the Alder Lake launch; they have been largely fixed with patches.
CPU-006.gerceklik.celiski: Some competitive players report more consistent frame times with E-cores off; other tests show no difference.
CPU-006.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Scheduling problems were seen on Windows 10 and in some old games; mostly solved on Windows 11.
rehber.adimlar: Use Windows 11 (Thread Director support).
If a specific old game has an E-core problem: instead of turning off E-cores in the BIOS, first update the game, then try a CPU set/affinity with Process Lasso.
CPU-006.rehber.geri_alma: Re-enable the E-cores in the BIOS.
CPU-006.rehber.kontrol: Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name, NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors; Task Manager > Performance > CPU.
CPU-006.uyumluluk.kaynak_metin.windows: Windows 11 recommended (Windows 10 has no Thread Director)

CPU-007.ne_ise_yarar: Stops each physical core from running two threads.
artilar: Reports of small 1% low improvements in some games (CPUs with 8+ cores)
eksiler: A clear performance loss on CPUs with few cores (4-6 cores)
A large loss in multi-threaded applications
dokunmamali: Users of 4-6 core CPUs
Streamers/renderers
CPU-007.gerceklik.aciklama: A small benefit in specific game + high core count combinations, a loss in others.
CPU-007.gerceklik.celiski: Review sites' SMT-off tests give opposite results depending on the game.
CPU-007.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Positive or negative depending on the game and core count; there is no general rule.
rehber.adimlar: BIOS > CPU settings > SMT / Hyper-Threading: Disabled.
CPU-007.rehber.kontrol: Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors  (if equal, SMT is off)

CPU-008.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents cores from entering deep sleep states.
artilar: Wake-up latency drops by microseconds (in measurement setups)
eksiler: Idle power and heat rise clearly
On Ryzen and modern Intel, the boost algorithm gains power budget from idle cores sleeping; single-core boost may drop
dokunmamali: Laptop users
Ryzen users (boost behavior may break)
CPU-008.gerceklik.aciklama: Common in latency-obsessed communities (Blur Busters forums); a measurable gaming benefit is disputed.
CPU-008.gerceklik.celiski: Some users report lower DPC latency; others measure a boost loss.
CPU-008.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No independent measurement showing a repeatable benefit in games was found; negative in some cases.
rehber.adimlar: Restart the computer and enter the BIOS (usually Del or F2 at startup).
Find the 'Global C-State Control' or 'C-States' setting in the CPU power management section.
Set it to Disabled, save and exit (F10). To undo, choose Auto/Enabled in the same place.
CPU-008.rehber.kontrol: BIOS > CPU power management > C-States / Global C-state Control. Indirectly from Windows: the powercfg /energy report.

CPU-009.ne_ise_yarar: Since Windows 10 2004, timeBeginPeriod only affects the calling process; on Windows 11 the request of processes whose windows are minimized/invisible is not guaranteed either. That is why 'timer resolution' tools may no longer affect the game. The community uses this registry value to bring back the old global behavior.
artilar: In old games that do not set their own timer, Sleep-based FPS limiters may become more precise
eksiler: A high system-wide interrupt rate: power use and laptop battery life get worse
Most modern games and engines already request their own timer resolution
dokunmamali: Laptop users
Anyone without a problem
CPU-009.gerceklik.aciklama: Microsoft documents the behavior change; the existence of the registry value was observed by the community, and there is no official user documentation.
CPU-009.gerceklik.celiski: Some 'timer resolution' tools are still recommended as 'FPS boosters' even though they no longer have a global effect on Windows 10 2004+.
CPU-009.performans_etkisi.gerekce: A small effect on frame time consistency is reported; there is no repeatable, broad measurement.
rehber.adimlar: Usually not needed.

To bring back the old (global) behavior on Windows 11: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\kernel' -Name GlobalTimerResolutionRequests -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force
CPU-009.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\kernel' -Name GlobalTimerResolutionRequests -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; current resolution: Sysinternals ClockRes (clockres.exe).

CPU-010.ad: Core assignment with Process Lasso / CPU affinity
CPU-010.ne_ise_yarar: Restricts which cores a process runs on.
artilar: Can fix scheduler mistakes in specific cases
eksiler: Used wrongly, it reduces the number of cores the game can use and lowers performance
Some anti-cheats block interference with the process
dokunmamali: Anyone without a specific problem
CPU-010.gerceklik.aciklama: The tool is real; the general advice 'set affinity in every game' is not. The gain is specific to the game and hardware: in one article (9950X3D, very low graphics settings) two games improved and one showed no difference; there is no general evidence.
CPU-010.performans_etkisi.gerekce: High if it fixes a problem; otherwise none or negative.
rehber.adimlar: Only for a specific problem (e.g. wrong CCD on X3D, an old game's many-core bug): a permanent CPU set/affinity rule with Process Lasso.
CPU-010.rehber.geri_alma: Delete the rule; select all cores.
CPU-010.rehber.kontrol: Task Manager > Details > process > Set affinity; Get-Process <name> | Select-Object ProcessorAffinity
CPU-010.sade_ad: Pinning programs to specific CPU cores

PWR-001.ad: Power plan: High Performance / Ultimate Performance
PWR-001.ne_ise_yarar: Ready-made profiles that change sub-settings such as core parking, minimum processor state and disk/USB/PCIe power saving toward performance.
artilar: A small improvement in boost response and frame time consistency on some systems
eksiler: Higher idle power use and heat
Lower battery life on laptops
Some modern laptops (Modern Standby) only have the Balanced plan; the Power mode is used instead of changing plans
dokunmamali: Ryzen 7900X3D/7950X3D/9900X3D/9950X3D users (AMD recommends the Balanced plan)
Laptop users running on battery
notlar: When the power plan changes, the plan settings in the Processor and Power menus (core parking, minimum processor state, etc.) must be applied again in the new plan.
PWR-001.gerceklik.aciklama: A real mechanism, but 'Ultimate Performance' is designed for workstations and no meaningful difference from High Performance has been shown in games. In one measurement on a single PC with 4 games, only one game's 1% low frame rate improved; the others showed either no difference or a slight dip.
PWR-001.gerceklik.celiski: Optimization videos present Ultimate Performance as a 'secret FPS mode'; Microsoft defines it for workstation workloads.
PWR-001.performans_etkisi.gerekce: On modern CPUs the Balanced plan also boosts quickly; in independent tests the difference is usually small. It may be clearer on older systems.
rehber.adimlar: High Performance: powercfg /setactive SCHEME_MIN.
Ultimate Performance (if not shown): powercfg -duplicatescheme e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61, then powercfg /setactive <GUID> with the new GUID from the list

PWR-002.ne_ise_yarar: The Windows power mode layer that changes CPU power limits and boost aggressiveness, especially on laptops.
artilar: A clear performance gain on a plugged-in laptop (depends on the OEM setting)
eksiler: Heat, fan noise, faster battery drain
dokunmamali: Anyone who wants to run on battery and quietly
notlar: The power mode only applies while the 'Balanced' power plan is active; in the High/Ultimate Performance plan it is already at the highest.
