Windows' undocumented power mode API is used (powercfg commands do not work on this Windows version).
PWR-002.gerceklik.aciklama: A documented power mode; one of the most important Windows settings for laptop performance.
PWR-002.performans_etkisi.gerekce: On a laptop, low to high depending on the power limits the OEM ties to this mode; usually low on desktops.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > System > Power & battery > Power mode: Best performance.
Command: powercfg /overlaysetactive ded574b5-45a0-4f42-8737-46345c09c238
PWR-002.rehber.kontrol: powercfg /getactiveoverlayscheme  (00000000-...=Balanced/Better performance, ded574b5-45a0-4f42-8737-46345c09c238=Best performance, 961cc777-2547-4f9d-8174-7d86181b8a7a=Best power efficiency)

PWR-003.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents idle USB devices from being put to sleep.
artilar: Can fix brief disconnects or first-movement delay of a mouse/keyboard/audio interface/DAC
eksiler: Lower battery life on laptops
dokunmamali: Laptop users who have no problem
PWR-003.gerceklik.aciklama: A real fix for disconnect/wake-up problems; not a performance setting. The mechanism is documented (delay while the device wakes up); the in-game effect has not been measured.
PWR-003.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Does not affect FPS; fixes USB device disconnects. Devices actively used during a game do not go to sleep anyway.
rehber.adimlar: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 2a737441-1930-4402-8d77-b2bebba308a3 48e6b7a6-50f5-4782-a5d4-53bb8f07e226 0; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
PWR-003.rehber.geri_alma: Set the value to 1 and activate the plan again.

PWR-004.ad: PCI Express Link State Power Management (ASPM)
PWR-004.ne_ise_yarar: Controls whether PCIe links (GPU, NVMe, NIC) go to a low power state when idle.
artilar: Rarely, fixes wake-up latency or instability problems of some NVMe/GPU/NIC devices
eksiler: Lower battery life on laptops
dokunmamali: Laptop users (if there is no problem)
PWR-004.varsayilan: Balanced: Moderate/Maximum (depends on the system); High Performance: Off.
PWR-004.gerceklik.aciklama: Real for stability on specific systems; no effect on FPS.
PWR-004.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Under load the links are already active; the effect is in the transition from idle to load.
rehber.adimlar: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 501a4d13-42af-4429-9fd1-a8218c268e20 ee12f906-d277-404b-b6da-e5fa1a576df5 0; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT  (0=Off, 1=Moderate, 2=Maximum savings)
PWR-004.rehber.geri_alma: Go back to the previous value (usually 1 or 2 in Balanced).

PWR-005.ad: Device Manager: 'Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power'
PWR-005.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents Windows from turning off individual devices to save power.
artilar: Can fix network disconnects and mouse/keyboard wake-up problems
eksiler: Lower battery life on laptops
dokunmamali: Laptop users who have no problem
PWR-005.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No effect if there are no disconnect/stability problems.
rehber.adimlar: Device Manager > USB Root Hub / Network adapter / HID device > Properties > Power Management > untick the box.
Command (admin): Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\wmi -ClassName MSPower_DeviceEnable | Where-Object InstanceName -like '*<device>*' | Set-CimInstance -Property @{Enable=$false}
PWR-005.rehber.geri_alma: Tick the box again or Enable=$true.
PWR-005.rehber.kontrol: Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\wmi -ClassName MSPower_DeviceEnable | Select-Object InstanceName, Enable

PWR-006.ad: Laptop: OEM performance mode, gaming plugged in and the MUX switch
PWR-006.ne_ise_yarar: On a laptop, CPU/GPU power limits and fan curves are set by OEM software and the EC more than by Windows.
artilar: One of the biggest single levers for laptop performance
With a MUX, the copy overhead and latency through the iGPU go away
eksiler: High fan noise and heat
Battery life gets much shorter in dGPU mode
dokunmamali: Users who put battery use first
PWR-006.gerceklik.aciklama: Laptop reviews consistently measure large differences between performance modes.
PWR-006.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Power limits directly determine GPU/CPU clock speeds; on battery or in silent mode gaming performance drops clearly.
rehber.adimlar: Plug in; choose Performance/Turbo mode in the OEM software; if there is a MUX, choose 'dGPU only/Ultimate' mode (requires a restart).
PWR-006.rehber.geri_alma: Go back to Balanced/Silent mode and Hybrid (MSHybrid/Optimus) mode.
PWR-006.rehber.kontrol: OEM software (Armoury Crate, Lenovo Vantage/Legion Space, MSI Center, Omen Gaming Hub, Alienware Command Center, etc.).

PWR-007.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents mechanical disks from spinning down when idle.
artilar: Prevents freezes of a few seconds caused by the disk spinning up again in games stored on an HDD
eksiler: Slightly more power and disk wear
dokunmamali: Anyone who only uses SSDs (no effect)
PWR-007.gerceklik.aciklama: HDD spin-up time is a physical delay.
PWR-007.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only matters when data is read from an HDD while the disk is asleep.
rehber.adimlar: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_DISK DISKIDLE 0; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT  (0 = never)
PWR-007.rehber.geri_alma: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_DISK DISKIDLE 1200; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT  (20 minutes)

PWR-008.ne_ise_yarar: Determines whether, as heat rises, the fans speed up first or the processor is slowed down first (on systems with ACPI support).
artilar: Prevents early throttling on laptops left in passive mode
eksiler: More fan noise
PWR-008.gerceklik.aciklama: Real on systems that use ACPI thermal zones; no effect on OEM-managed systems.
PWR-008.performans_etkisi.gerekce: On many modern laptops the EC/OEM software manages the fans and this setting may have no effect.
rehber.adimlar: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR SYSCOOLPOL 1; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT  (1=Active: speed up the fan first, 0=Passive: slow down the processor first)
PWR-008.rehber.geri_alma: Go back to the previous value.

NET-001.ne_ise_yarar: Removes packet loss, jitter (latency fluctuation) and ping spikes caused by background scanning on a wireless connection.
artilar: More consistent ping and near-zero packet loss
eksiler: Running a cable can be hard
NET-001.gerceklik.aciklama: Based on network physics; consistent advice across all sources.
NET-001.performans_etkisi.gerekce: A wireless connection is one of the biggest local causes of the 'lag' felt in online games; the effect depends on the environment.
rehber.adimlar: Use a cable if possible.
If not: the 5/6 GHz band, being close to the router, avoiding channel congestion.
NET-001.rehber.kontrol: Get-NetAdapter | Select-Object Name, InterfaceDescription, Status, LinkSpeed; Wi-Fi signal: netsh wlan show interfaces

NET-002.ad: Wi-Fi adapter power saving: Maximum performance
NET-002.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents the wireless card from going to sleep to save power.
artilar: Can reduce periodic ping spikes on laptops
eksiler: Lower battery life
dokunmamali: Anyone using a wired connection (no effect)
NET-002.varsayilan: Usually Maximum performance when plugged in; power saving on battery.
NET-002.gerceklik.aciklama: Wireless power saving is a known source of latency; the effect depends on the card and driver.
NET-002.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Matters on battery or with drivers that save power aggressively.
rehber.adimlar: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 19cbb8fa-5279-450e-9fac-8a3d5fedd0c1 12bbebe6-58d6-4636-95bb-3217ef867c1a 0; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT  (0=Maximum performance, 3=Maximum power saving).
Also the 'MIMO Power Save' / 'Roaming Aggressiveness' settings in the adapter's Advanced properties.
NET-002.rehber.geri_alma: Go back to the previous value.

NET-003.ne_ise_yarar: Windows periodically scans for nearby networks even while connected; on many cards there is a ping spike at regular intervals during this scan.
artilar: Can remove ping spikes that repeat at regular intervals
eksiler: If the connection drops it does not reconnect automatically; the network list is not updated
Forgetting to turn it back on looks like a connection problem at the next startup
dokunmamali: Users who often connect to/disconnect from Wi-Fi or change networks (turn it back on at the end of the session)
NET-003.gerceklik.aciklama: Background scanning causing latency spikes is a known behavior of wireless cards; regularly spaced ping spikes are a sign of this problem.
NET-003.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Clear on systems with scan-related ping spikes; none on others.
rehber.adimlar: While connected, before playing: netsh wlan set autoconfig enabled=no interface="<Wi-Fi interface name>".
Also, if Location services are on, Wi-Fi scans may be triggered.
NET-003.rehber.geri_alma: netsh wlan set autoconfig enabled=yes interface="<Wi-Fi interface name>"
NET-003.rehber.kontrol: netsh wlan show settings  (Auto configuration state)
notlar: While off, if the Wi-Fi connection drops it does not reconnect on its own and the network list is not updated. Turn this setting off when the game ends (Changes > Restore also does the same).

NET-004.ad: Bufferbloat: SQM / smart queue (QoS) on the router
NET-004.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents ping from shooting up (bufferbloat) while someone else at home downloads/uploads/streams video.
artilar: Ping consistency under load improves greatly on a shared connection
eksiler: Maximum download speed may drop slightly
The router's CPU may not keep up at high speeds
dokunmamali: ISP modems without SQM support (check whether it is supported first)
NET-004.gerceklik.aciklama: Not a Windows setting; but one of the few common methods that really delivers the ping improvement 'network tweaks' promise.
NET-004.performans_etkisi.gerekce: High if the connection is shared with other users; none for a single user on an idle line.
rehber.adimlar: Turn on SQM (fq_codel/cake) or 'Smart Queue'/'Adaptive QoS' on the router and set the bandwidth slightly below the real speed.
NET-004.rehber.kontrol: Bufferbloat test (e.g. Waveform Bufferbloat Test): measures the latency increase under load.

NET-005.ad: Turn off Delivery Optimization peer-to-peer uploads
NET-005.ne_ise_yarar: Limits uploading Windows/Store updates to other computers and background bandwidth use.
artilar: Prevents ping increases caused by background uploads (especially on lines with low upload speed)
eksiler: Several PCs on the same network download updates separately
dokunmamali: On local networks with many PCs, the 'local network only' option is more efficient
notlar: This is a policy: while it is on, the Delivery Optimization option in Settings appears grayed out (cannot be changed).
NET-005.varsayilan: PCs on the local network (depends on the version).
NET-005.gerceklik.aciklama: A documented Microsoft feature; the effect depends on connection capacity.
NET-005.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only matters during an active update transfer.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > Windows Update > Advanced options > Delivery Optimization > 'Allow downloads from other PCs': Off (or local network only).
Policy: DODownloadMode=0 (HTTP only).
Also an upload/download bandwidth limit under Advanced options.
NET-005.rehber.geri_alma: Turn the setting on; delete the policy value: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization' -Name DODownloadMode

NET-006.ne_ise_yarar: TcpAckFrequency=1 turns off delayed ACK. Nagle's algorithm combines small TCP packets; turning it off is done on the application side with TCP_NODELAY.
artilar: Responsiveness may improve in old games that use TCP and do not set TCP_NODELAY (e.g. some MMOs)
eksiler: Network traffic and CPU use increase slightly
Most modern games use UDP; no effect in those games
dokunmamali: Anyone playing UDP-based games (no effect)
NET-006.gerceklik.aciklama: TcpAckFrequency is documented by Microsoft. Because most modern competitive games use UDP, the general claim that it 'lowers ping' is wrong.
NET-006.gerceklik.celiski: There are community analyses claiming the TCPNoDelay registry value is not read by tcpip.sys on modern Windows; this is disputed. Games like World of Warcraft offer their own 'optimize network for speed' option for this reason.
NET-006.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only in TCP-based games that do not turn off Nagle themselves; none in others.
rehber.adimlar: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\<InterfaceGuid>' -Name TcpAckFrequency -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path '...\<InterfaceGuid>' -Name TCPNoDelay -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force
NET-006.rehber.kontrol: Get-NetAdapter | Select-Object Name, InterfaceGuid; Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\<InterfaceGuid>' | Select-Object TcpAckFrequency, TCPNoDelay

NET-007.ne_ise_yarar: Turns off the network card grouping interrupts instead of raising a separate interrupt for each packet.
artilar: Packet processing latency on the local network drops by microseconds
eksiler: CPU use and interrupt count rise under heavy traffic
dokunmamali: Systems with a weak CPU that do high-speed file transfers
notlar: While applying, the network card drops the connection for a few seconds; do not apply it during a game or download.
NET-007.gerceklik.aciklama: The mechanism is real (Microsoft NIC tuning guide); in practice placebo for game ping. In one measurement on a single card (Intel Gigabit CT, Windows 10 1909) there were ~2.65 million interrupts with moderation off against ~200 thousand with adaptive; the 'medium' setting had the least impact on gaming and kept DPC latency low.
NET-007.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Next to an internet game ping of milliseconds, a gain of microseconds is not measurable.
rehber.adimlar: Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name '<Ethernet>' -RegistryKeyword '*InterruptModeration' -RegistryValue 0

NET-008.ad: Turn off Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE / Green Ethernet)
NET-008.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents the link from switching to a low power mode when idle.
artilar: Can fix link drops and wake-up delay with some switch/router combinations
eksiler: Very slightly more power use
notlar: While applying, the network card drops the connection for a few seconds.
NET-008.gerceklik.aciklama: A real fix for compatibility problems; not a general performance gain. Intel's documentation only describes link-speed problems; the latency effect has not been measured.
NET-008.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No effect on ping if there is no problem.
rehber.adimlar: Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name '<Ethernet>' -DisplayName '<Energy-Efficient Ethernet>' -DisplayValue 'Disabled'  (the name and keyword depend on the manufacturer: Realtek, Intel, etc.)

NET-009.ad: Receive Side Scaling (RSS) and offload settings
NET-009.ne_ise_yarar: RSS spreads incoming traffic across several cores; offloads move some work from the CPU to the network card.
artilar: The defaults give the best result in most cases
eksiler: The 'turn off all offloads' advice found online increases CPU load
dokunmamali: Anyone without a problem (do not change)
notlar: While applying, the network card drops the connection for a few seconds.
NET-009.gerceklik.aciklama: The claim that disabling offload/RSS 'lowers ping' has no evidence; Microsoft recommends the defaults.
NET-009.performans_etkisi.gerekce: When the defaults are kept; turning them off does not improve game ping.
rehber.adimlar: Recommended: keep RSS enabled (Enable-NetAdapterRss -Name '<Ethernet>').
Turn off LSO/Checksum offload only if there is a documented driver bug.
NET-009.rehber.kontrol: Get-NetAdapterRss -Name '<Ethernet>'; netsh int tcp show global; Get-NetAdapterLso -Name '<Ethernet>'

INP-001.ad: Polling rate (report rate) – reading and setting
INP-001.ne_ise_yarar: Determines how many times per second the mouse sends its position to the computer. 125 Hz = 8 ms, 1000 Hz = 1 ms, 8000 Hz = 0.125 ms interval.
artilar: Going from 125 Hz to 1000 Hz clearly reduces average input latency and unevenness in cursor movement
Smoother cursor on high refresh rate monitors
eksiler: 4000-8000 Hz increases CPU load; stutter/FPS drops have been reported in some games (especially on Windows 10 and with apps listening to raw input in the background)
Battery life of wireless mice drops clearly
dokunmamali: Do not use 4000/8000 Hz on systems with a weak CPU
If high polling causes stutter in old games, go back to 1000 Hz
INP-001.varsayilan: Depends on the mouse (most gaming mice 1000 Hz, office mice usually 125 Hz).
INP-001.gerceklik.aciklama: The report interval is a physical latency component. Stutter caused by high polling has also been acknowledged by Microsoft engineers, and background listeners were restricted in Windows 11.
INP-001.gerceklik.celiski: Whether 8000 Hz gives a noticeable benefit is disputed; Blur Busters argues for cursor smoothness on high refresh rate monitors, others point to the CPU cost.
INP-001.performans_etkisi.gerekce: 125→1000 Hz is a real, measurable improvement in input latency (the interval between reports goes from 8 ms to 1 ms). Above 1000 Hz the gain shrinks and the CPU cost rises.
rehber.adimlar: Mouse software (G HUB, Synapse, GG, etc.), a button combination on the mouse or an onboard profile.
Recommended starting point: 1000 Hz.
2000-8000 Hz only with a powerful CPU and games that support it.
INP-001.rehber.geri_alma: The previous value in the same software.
INP-001.rehber.kontrol: There is NO reliable direct reading in Windows. Options: (1) the endpoint bInterval value with USBView / USB Device Tree Viewer (upper limit only); (2) measuring with Raw Input WM_INPUT timestamps (while moving the mouse continuously); (3) 'pointerrawupdate'-based test pages in a Chromium browser (rough check); (4) the manufacturer's software (the set value). Details: arastirma_notlari.mouse_polling_rate

INP-002.ad: Turn off Enhance Pointer Precision (mouse acceleration)
INP-002.ne_ise_yarar: Turns off Windows mouse acceleration: cursor distance depends only on how far you move the mouse, not how fast.
artilar: Consistent muscle memory; aim consistency on the desktop and in games that do not use raw input
eksiler: Moving across a large screen with a low-DPI mouse can be more tiring
dokunmamali: Office/laptop touchpad users used to acceleration (the touchpad has its own setting)
INP-002.gerceklik.aciklama: The acceleration curve defined in Microsoft's pointer ballistics documentation.
INP-002.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No FPS/latency effect; affects input consistency. Games that use raw input skip this setting anyway.
rehber.adimlar: main.cpl > Pointer Options > untick 'Enhance pointer precision'.

Command: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseSpeed -Value '0'; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseThreshold1 -Value '0'; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseThreshold2 -Value '0'  (a change via the registry takes effect at sign-in; the UI applies it immediately)
INP-002.rehber.geri_alma: Tick the box or set the values to '1', '6', '10'.
INP-002.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' | Select-Object MouseSpeed, MouseThreshold1, MouseThreshold2  (1/6/10 = on, 0/0/0 = off)

INP-003.ad: Pointer speed 10/20 (6/11 in the old UI) – 1:1 mapping
INP-003.ne_ise_yarar: At 10 (with acceleration off) one mouse count moves exactly one pixel. Higher values skip pixels, lower values lose movement.
artilar: Precise, lossless movement on the desktop and in games that do not use raw input
eksiler: None (compensated with DPI)
INP-003.gerceklik.aciklama: The Windows pointer multiplier is documented; 10 = 1.0 multiplier.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Mouse > Mouse pointer speed: 10.
Command: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseSensitivity -Value '10'.
Adjust sensitivity with the mouse DPI and in-game sensitivity.
INP-003.rehber.geri_alma: Go back to the previous value.

INP-004.ne_ise_yarar: The game gets mouse data directly, without going through Windows pointer ballistics (acceleration, speed multiplier).
artilar: Consistent aim, independent of Windows mouse settings
eksiler: The raw input implementation may be buggy in some very old games
INP-004.gerceklik.aciklama: The Raw Input API is documented by Microsoft.
INP-004.performans_etkisi.gerekce: A consistency setting; the latency difference depends on the implementation and is usually negligible.
rehber.adimlar: If the game supports it, Raw Input: On.

INP-005.ne_ise_yarar: Flattens the acceleration curve so it produces 1:1 movement even with the acceleration box ticked.
artilar: 1:1 movement in old games that force acceleration
eksiler: Unnecessary in most modern games
The file for the wrong DPI scale gives the wrong speed
dokunmamali: Anyone playing games that use raw input
Users who already turned acceleration off
INP-005.gerceklik.aciklama: A real fix for specific old games; unnecessary for most users today.
rehber.adimlar: Only for old games that force acceleration on and do not support raw input: apply MarkC's .reg file for your display scale (100/125/150%).
INP-005.rehber.geri_alma: Apply the 'Windows Default' .reg file from the MarkC package.

INP-006.ad: Keyboard repeat delay and repeat rate
INP-006.ne_ise_yarar: Determines how soon repeating starts when you hold a key and how fast it continues.
artilar: Feels faster when editing text and in menus
eksiler: Accidental double letters with a short delay
INP-006.gerceklik.aciklama: Real for desktop comfort; the claim that it 'reduces keyboard latency in games' is wrong. This is a usage preference; there is no evidence of a performance effect.
INP-006.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Games read key press/release events directly; repeat settings do not affect in-game response.
rehber.adimlar: control keyboard > Repeat delay: Short, Repeat rate: Fast.
Command: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Keyboard' -Name KeyboardDelay -Value '0'; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Keyboard' -Name KeyboardSpeed -Value '31'

INP-007.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents the window that appears, and throws you out of the game to the desktop, when you press Shift 5 times or hold right Shift for 8 seconds.
artilar: No more getting thrown to the desktop in the middle of a game
eksiler: Shortcut access to accessibility features is lost
dokunmamali: Anyone who uses these accessibility features
INP-007.gerceklik.aciklama: A common and useful QoL setting.
rehber.adimlar: Settings > Accessibility > Keyboard > Sticky/Filter/Toggle keys > turn off the keyboard shortcut.
Command: StickyKeys Flags='506', Keyboard Response Flags='122', ToggleKeys Flags='58'
INP-007.rehber.geri_alma: StickyKeys Flags='510', Keyboard Response Flags='126', ToggleKeys Flags='62'
INP-007.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys' -Name Flags; Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response' -Name Flags; Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\ToggleKeys' -Name Flags

INP-008.ad: USB port choice and wireless receiver placement
INP-008.ne_ise_yarar: Shared hubs, front-panel cables and 2.4 GHz interference from USB 3.0 can cause packet loss and erratic cursor movement with wireless mice.
artilar: More stable polling, especially at 4000/8000 Hz and with wireless mice
eksiler: Cable management
INP-008.gerceklik.aciklama: Mouse manufacturers (Logitech, Razer, etc.) recommend keeping the receiver close and avoiding USB 3.0 interference; USB 3.0's 2.4 GHz interference is documented by Intel.
INP-008.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Clear on setups with an interference/sharing problem; none on others.
rehber.adimlar: Plug the mouse/receiver directly into a port on the motherboard (preferably one connected to the CPU); avoid hubs, monitor USB ports and front-panel cables.
Put the wireless receiver close to the mouse with an extension cable; keep it away from 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and USB 3.0 interference.
INP-008.rehber.kontrol: USBView / Device Manager > View > Devices by connection: which controller/hub the mouse is connected through.

INP-009.ad: Reduce apps listening to raw input in the background (high polling stutter)
INP-009.ne_ise_yarar: Every mouse report is delivered to all apps registered for raw input. Many background listeners can cause stutter by delaying rendering while the game drains its input queue. In Windows 11 Insider build 25272 (2023) Microsoft announced a change that rate-limits and coalesces messages for background listeners.
artilar: Fewer FPS drops triggered by mouse movement with high polling rate mice
eksiler: Some utility software has to be closed while gaming
INP-009.gerceklik.aciklama: Microsoft engineers' explanation was relayed on the Blur Busters forum. Which stable Windows 11 version the change shipped in could not be confirmed with official release notes in this research.
INP-009.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Clear on affected systems (Windows 10, many listeners, 4-8 kHz mouse); expected to be reduced on current Windows 11 versions.
rehber.adimlar: Close unnecessary background apps while gaming; keep Windows 11 up to date (background raw input listeners are restricted by the system); if the problem persists, lower the polling rate to 1000 Hz.
INP-009.rehber.kontrol: There is no direct Windows command. Symptom: if FPS drops when you move the mouse at high polling (1000 Hz+), test by closing background RGB/macro software, overlays, screen recorders and browsers.

INP-010.ne_ise_yarar: Tries to raise 125 Hz to 500/1000 Hz on old mice that do not offer a polling rate setting in software.
artilar: Lower input latency on old 125 Hz mice (if the mouse firmware supports it)
eksiler: Test signing mode is incompatible with Secure Boot and anti-cheat (Vanguard, FACEIT, EAC); games may not start
Repeated/corrupted reports if the firmware does not support it
dokunmamali: Anyone playing competitive games with anti-cheat
Systems that require Secure Boot
INP-010.bilgi.neden: Shown to work on some old mice by community measurements; the security and compatibility cost is high.
INP-010.bilgi.yapilamaz_nedeni: Requires installing a separate, unsigned driver; this app does not install third-party drivers.
INP-010.gerceklik.aciklama: Shown to work on some old mice by community measurements; the security and compatibility cost is high.
INP-010.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Depends on the mouse; unnecessary with modern gaming mice.
INP-010.uyumluluk.kaynak_metin.windows: Windows 10, Windows 11 (hard because of driver signing requirements)

AUD-001.ne_ise_yarar: Bypasses the effects the audio driver and Windows apply to the audio signal (bass boost, virtual surround, loudness equalization, Nahimic/Dolby/Sonic Studio processing).
artilar: Fixes crackling, latency, crashes and app incompatibilities caused by some APOs
Audio is played as is, without being altered
eksiler: Users who rely on effects (e.g. loudness equalization, microphone noise suppression) lose these features
On some laptops speaker protection/equalizer effects are turned off too, and the sound may become weaker and tinnier
dokunmamali: Users whose laptop speakers sound clearly worse when the manufacturer's equalizer is turned off
Anyone who deliberately uses loudness equalization (see AUD-007)
notlar: Audio cuts out for a few seconds while applying (the Windows Audio service is restarted).
Can be turned on/off separately for each output device.
AUD-001.varsayilan: Depends on the driver; on for most devices.
AUD-001.gerceklik.aciklama: A real fix for problematic driver effects; no evidence for the claim that it 'increases FPS'.
AUD-001.gerceklik.celiski: Microsoft's documentation gives the property type as VT_UI4 in one version and VT_BOOL in an older one. The registry mapping is not officially documented (see arastirma_notlari.ses_gelistirmeleri_ve_format).
AUD-001.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The CPU cost of APOs is usually small; the real benefit is stability with problematic APOs (DPC latency, crashes).
rehber.adimlar: Recommended: Windows 11 Settings > Sound > device > Audio enhancements: Off; Windows 10: mmsys.cpl > device > Properties > Enhancements > 'Disable all enhancements'.
API: IMMDevice::OpenPropertyStore(STGM_READWRITE) > SetValue(PKEY_AudioEndpoint_Disable_SysFx, VT_UI4 = 1).
Registry (there may be permission problems): under FxProperties '{1da5d803-d492-4edd-8c23-e0c0ffee7f0e},5' = 1 (DWORD), then Restart-Service Audiosrv -Force
AUD-001.rehber.geri_alma: Turn enhancements on in the UI or set the value to 0 / delete it, then Restart-Service Audiosrv -Force
AUD-001.rehber.kontrol: UI: Settings > System > Sound > <device> > Audio enhancements. Endpoint GUIDs: Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\MMDevices\Audio\Render'. artilar: Specific scenarios on file servers (LargeSystemCache)
eksiler: On a desktop, LargeSystemCache can reduce the memory available to apps; problems with some old drivers have been reported
dokunmamali: Desktop/gaming systems
PLC-007.gerceklik.aciklama: Left over from Windows XP-era tweak lists.
PLC-007.performans_etkisi.gerekce: On systems with enough RAM the kernel is practically never paged anyway; no gaming improvement has been shown.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended.
PLC-007.rehber.geri_alma: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' -Name LargeSystemCache -Value 0; Set-ItemProperty -Path '...\Memory Management' -Name DisablePagingExecutive -Value 0
PLC-007.rehber.kontrol: Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' | Select-Object LargeSystemCache, DisablePagingExecutive
PLC-007.tespit.mesaj: LargeSystemCache or DisablePagingExecutive has been changed (a 'tweak' may have been applied before).

PLC-008.ne_ise_yarar: Turning off virtual memory with the idea 'I have lots of RAM, I don't need a page file'.
artilar: A few GB of disk space
eksiler: The commit limit is capped at RAM: large games may crash with an 'out of memory' error
Blue screen dump files cannot be created
Some apps assume a page file exists
dokunmamali: Everyone
PLC-008.bilgi.neden: Microsoft explains that the page file is needed for the commit limit and for dump files.
PLC-008.bilgi.yapilamaz_nedeni: For your safety, this setting is never applied from the app.
PLC-008.gerceklik.aciklama: Microsoft explains that the page file is needed for the commit limit and for dump files.
PLC-008.performans_etkisi.gerekce: With enough RAM the page file is used little anyway; turning it off gains no speed and lowers stability.
PLC-008.rehber.geri_alma: SystemPropertiesPerformance.exe > Advanced > Virtual memory > 'Automatically manage paging file size for all drives'.
PLC-008.rehber.kontrol: Get-CimInstance Win32_PageFileUsage | Select-Object Name, AllocatedBaseSize, CurrentUsage; Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object AutomaticManagedPagefile
PLC-008.tespit.mesaj: The page file (virtual memory) appears to be turned off. This can cause programs to crash when memory runs out.

PLC-009.ad: Defragmenting an SSD / turning off 'Optimize Drives'
PLC-009.ne_ise_yarar: Two opposite myths: (1) 'defragment your SSD regularly', (2) 'it harms the SSD, turn optimization off'. Windows recognizes the SSD and sends TRIM instead of defragmenting.
artilar: The default behavior keeps SSD performance
eksiler: Turning off the task also turns off scheduled TRIM; write performance may drop in the long run
Forcing a defrag of an SSD with third-party defragmenters causes unnecessary writes
dokunmamali: Everyone (keep the default)
notlar: The weekly TRIM on SSDs stops too.
PLC-009.varsayilan: Weekly optimization on; TRIM (retrim) is done on SSDs.
PLC-009.gerceklik.aciklama: Since Windows 8, Optimize Drives detects SSDs. Occasionally doing a real defrag on systems with volume shadow copy enabled is intentional.
PLC-009.gerceklik.celiski: Some guides recommend turning the task off; this also turns off TRIM.
PLC-009.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The default works correctly; changing it gains nothing.
rehber.adimlar: Leave it at the default: keep the scheduled 'Optimize Drives' on.
PLC-009.rehber.geri_alma: Optimize-Volume -DriveLetter C -ReTrim -Verbose (triggers TRIM manually); re-enable the scheduled task.
PLC-009.rehber.kontrol: Get-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\Defrag\' | Select-Object TaskName, State; fsutil behavior query DisableDeleteNotify  (0 = TRIM on)

PLC-010.ne_ise_yarar: Determines how much of the CPU multimedia threads registered with MMCSS leave to low-priority work.
artilar: None (for games)
eksiler: May affect the background tasks of audio/streaming software
dokunmamali: Everyone
PLC-010.gerceklik.aciklama: The advice 'set it to 0' contradicts the official documentation: the value is rounded up to 10.
PLC-010.performans_etkisi.gerekce: According to Microsoft's documentation, values below 10 are treated as 10 (writing 0 is the same as writing 10). It only affects threads registered with MMCSS; most games do not use MMCSS.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended (no effect).
PLC-010.sade_ad: Removing the CPU share reserved for background tasks

PLC-011.ne_ise_yarar: Limits the processing rate of non-multimedia network packets while multimedia (audio/video) is playing. It was added in the Windows Vista era to prevent audio dropouts.
artilar: Throughput in a scenario with very high-speed (gigabit+) transfers while playing audio at the same time
eksiler: Practically none
PLC-011.gerceklik.aciklama: The claim that it 'lowers ping' does not match the mechanism.
PLC-011.gerceklik.celiski: Found in almost every 'gaming tweak' pack; no controlled measurement shows a ping improvement.
PLC-011.performans_etkisi.gerekce: It is a throughput limit; it does not change game ping over the internet.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended (no effect on ping).

PLC-012.ad: MMCSS 'Games' task profile (GPU Priority=8, Priority=6, Scheduling Category=High)
PLC-012.ne_ise_yarar: Determines the MMCSS priority of threads that call AvSetMmThreadCharacteristics('Games').
artilar: None (if games do not use this task)
eksiler: Practically none
PLC-012.gerceklik.aciklama: The mechanism is documented, but its target audience (games that use MMCSS) barely exists.
PLC-012.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only affects threads that register themselves with the MMCSS 'Games' task; the vast majority of games do not.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended (no effect).
PLC-012.rehber.geri_alma: Default values: GPU Priority=8, Priority=2, Scheduling Category='Medium', SFIO Priority='Normal'

PLC-013.ad: 'The QoS packet scheduler reserves 20% of bandwidth' (NonBestEffortLimit=0)
PLC-013.ne_ise_yarar: The claim that Windows 'reserves' 20% of bandwidth and that it can be freed.
artilar: None
eksiler: None (no effect)
PLC-013.gerceklik.aciklama: A misunderstanding left over from the Windows XP era.
PLC-013.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Since the Windows XP era Microsoft has explained that no bandwidth is reserved unless an app specifically requests QoS priority.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended (no effect).

PLC-014.ne_ise_yarar: DNS only translates domain names to IP addresses; once the connection is made, packets to the game server do not go through DNS.
artilar: The first lookup time when opening web pages may get shorter
Errors/blocks in some ISP DNS servers are bypassed
eksiler: Some CDNs may route you to a geographically farther server
notlar: Applied to all connected network cards.
Do not change it if you use a DNS tool such as DNSCrypt or a VPN; your connection may break.
PLC-014.gerceklik.aciklama: A claim that contradicts how the network protocol works.
PLC-014.performans_etkisi.gerekce: In-game latency (ping) is independent of DNS.
rehber.adimlar: Changing DNS for privacy/reliability is legitimate; it is unnecessary for ping.

artilar: None (except with a broken IPv6 configuration)
eksiler: Microsoft considers this an untested configuration; some Windows components may break
Xbox networking (Teredo) and multiplayer NAT traversal in some games may be affected
Connection problems with IPv6-first ISPs
dokunmamali: Everyone
PLC-015.gerceklik.aciklama: Microsoft explicitly recommends not disabling IPv6.
PLC-015.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The presence of IPv6 does not slow down IPv4 connections.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended.
If there is a real IPv6 problem, Microsoft's recommended approach is not to turn off IPv6 but to prefer IPv4: DisabledComponents=0x20.
PLC-015.tespit.mesaj: IPv6 has been turned off completely through the registry. Microsoft does not recommend this; some Windows features and game networking may have problems.

PLC-016.ad: Turn off TCP receive window auto-tuning (autotuninglevel=disabled)
PLC-016.ne_ise_yarar: Prevents the TCP receive window from growing with the connection.
artilar: Very rarely, compatibility with buggy network devices
eksiler: Download speed drops seriously (especially on high-latency/high-speed connections); Steam/game updates slow down
dokunmamali: Everyone
PLC-016.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No effect on game ping; a negative effect on download speed.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended.
PLC-016.rehber.geri_alma: netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal
PLC-016.rehber.kontrol: netsh int tcp show global  ('Receive Window Auto-Tuning Level')
PLC-016.tespit.mesaj: TCP receive window auto-tuning has been turned off. This can seriously lower download speed.
PLC-016.sade_ad: Turning off automatic network receive tuning

PLC-017.ne_ise_yarar: Sets the buffer capacity (number of events) of the mouse/keyboard class driver. It is claimed that 'shrinking it reduces latency'.
artilar: None
eksiler: With very small values, lost events (skipped movement/keys), especially at high polling rates
dokunmamali: Everyone
notlar: This harmful setting cannot be turned on from the app; you can only turn it off if it has been applied on your computer (it returns to the default 100).
PLC-017.gerceklik.aciklama: djdallmann's GamingPCSetup research shows this value does not improve latency and that low values risk data loss.
PLC-017.gerceklik.celiski: Some 'pro tweak' packs recommend values like 16-20.
PLC-017.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The queue size is only a capacity; events do not wait for it to fill, so shrinking the buffer does not reduce latency.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended.
PLC-017.tespit.mesaj: The mouse/keyboard data queue has been shrunk. This can cause inputs to be lost during fast movement.

PLC-018.ad: Running the game at 'Realtime' priority; raising csrss/dwm priority
PLC-018.ne_ise_yarar: Giving the game or system processes the highest CPU priority.
artilar: None
eksiler: Realtime priority can starve input, audio, disk and driver threads: mouse freezes, audio dropouts, system hangs
csrss.exe is a protected process; IFEO interference can have unpredictable results
dokunmamali: Everyone
PLC-018.bilgi.neden: Microsoft documents that Realtime priority can block system threads.
PLC-018.bilgi.yapilamaz_nedeni: For your safety, this setting is never applied from the app.
PLC-018.gerceklik.aciklama: Microsoft documents that Realtime priority can block system threads.
PLC-018.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No positive effect has been shown; the risk of a negative effect is high. For 'High' priority see PERF-010 (situational).
PLC-018.tespit.mesaj: A priority change has been applied for csrss.exe. This can break system stability.

PLC-019.ne_ise_yarar: The claim that it 'gives priority to the system clock/mouse interrupt'.
artilar: None
eksiler: None (Windows does not read this value)
notlar: Cannot be turned on from the app because there is no value to apply in the database; if it has been applied, you can turn it off.
PLC-019.gerceklik.aciklama: A myth circulating since the late 1990s.
PLC-019.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The Windows NT kernel manages interrupt priority through IRQL and the APIC; these registry values are not used.
rehber.adimlar: No effect.

artilar: Faster file-heavy operations (installs, builds)
eksiler: No protection against malware
Because of Tamper Protection, registry methods usually do not work or are reverted on modern versions
Some of the scripts that do this 'tweak' contain malware themselves
dokunmamali: Everyone
PLC-020.bilgi.neden: The in-game gain is within measurement error; the security cost is very high.
PLC-020.bilgi.yapilamaz_nedeni: Turning Defender off completely (services, policies) is never done from the app. Only real-time protection can be turned off, with a warning and confirmation, from the Defender card in the System menu.
PLC-020.gerceklik.aciklama: The in-game gain is within measurement error; the security cost is very high.
PLC-020.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The effect on FPS while a game runs is usually negligible; the difference shows in file-access-heavy operations.
PLC-020.tespit.mesaj: Windows Defender real-time protection appears to be off. If you do not use another antivirus, your computer is unprotected.

artilar: No unexpected restarts
eksiler: Security holes are not closed
Microsoft Store/Game Pass, DirectX components and some anti-cheats may expect an up-to-date system
The Windows Update Medic service may revert the changes
dokunmamali: Everyone
PLC-021.bilgi.neden: Active hours and pausing give the same benefit without the risk.
PLC-021.bilgi.yapilamaz_nedeni: For your safety, this setting is never applied from the app.
PLC-021.gerceklik.aciklama: Active hours and pausing give the same benefit without the risk.
PLC-021.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The service creates no load when there are no updates; the effect is only at update time and is solved by pausing.
PLC-021.tespit.mesaj: The Windows Update service has been disabled. Security updates are not arriving.

PLC-022.ad: Aggressive debloat scripts (removing Store, Xbox, Edge WebView2, Game Bar)
PLC-022.ne_ise_yarar: Removing preinstalled apps and components in bulk.
artilar: Fewer preinstalled apps, some disk space
eksiler: Game Pass, the Xbox app and Store updates break
Apps that depend on WebView2 (Teams, Widgets, many launchers) stop working
On dual-CCD Ryzen X3D, removing Game Bar breaks game detection
Some scripts make changes that cannot be undone
dokunmamali: Everyone (especially Game Pass and X3D users)
PLC-022.bilgi.neden: Bulk removal carries a high risk of breakage for a small gain.
PLC-022.bilgi.yapilamaz_nedeni: For your safety, this setting is never applied from the app.
PLC-022.gerceklik.aciklama: Bulk removal carries a high risk of breakage for a small gain.
PLC-022.gerceklik.celiski: Some debloat projects offer undo and a selective mode; the problem is the one-click 'remove everything' modes.
PLC-022.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Most of the removed apps use no resources unless they run.

PLC-023.ad: Regularly deleting the Prefetch / Temp folders 'increases FPS'
PLC-023.ne_ise_yarar: Deleting temporary files and app launch traces.
artilar: Cleaning Temp frees disk space
eksiler: Deleting Prefetch slows app launches for a while
notlar: Cannot be undone. Files in use are skipped. If Prefetch is deleted, programs open more slowly the first time for a while.
PLC-023.gerceklik.aciklama: Meaningful for disk space, placebo for performance; counterproductive for Prefetch.
PLC-023.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Game FPS is not affected by the presence of temporary files or prefetch files.
rehber.adimlar: For cleaning Temp, Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files or Storage Sense is enough.
Do not delete Prefetch.
PLC-023.rehber.geri_alma: Prefetch rebuilds itself (first launches are slower).
PLC-023.rehber.kontrol: Get-ChildItem C:\Windows\Prefetch | Measure-Object; Get-ChildItem $env:TEMP -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum

PLC-024.ne_ise_yarar: Applies some of the settings in this database (disabling services, power plan, registry values, ending background processes) in bulk. Commercial tools like Hone.gg and tweak packs on Nexus Mods are in this class.
artilar: The part that closes background apps can give a real benefit on systems with low RAM
Some offer undo
eksiler: Which setting had an effect cannot be separated
May also contain placebo and harmful settings (this category)
User reviews also report driver, display and boot problems
Some free 'boosters' contain adware
dokunmamali: Corporate computers
Tools whose actions you cannot see
PLC-024.bilgi.neden: They are only as effective as the real settings they contain; because everything is applied at once, cause and effect cannot be traced.
PLC-024.bilgi.yapilamaz_nedeni: It is a separate kind of program; this app already lists, backs up and undoes every change.
PLC-024.gerceklik.aciklama: They are only as effective as the real settings they contain; because everything is applied at once, cause and effect cannot be traced.
PLC-024.gerceklik.celiski: On platforms like Trustpilot there are both positive (FPS gain) and negative (driver/display/boot problem) reviews.
PLC-024.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No independent, controlled measurement was found; manufacturer claims and user reviews are mixed.

PLC-025.ad: Turning off NVIDIA telemetry/background services 'increases FPS'
PLC-025.ne_ise_yarar: Turning off NVIDIA's driver helper services and telemetry.
artilar: Privacy (telemetry)
eksiler: The Control Panel, overlay and some driver features stop working
dokunmamali: NVIDIA Control Panel users
notlar: Some features of the NVIDIA Control Panel and NVIDIA App stop working.
PLC-025.gerceklik.aciklama: Understandable for privacy, placebo for performance. Not installing the telemetry components at all with NVCleanstall is a cleaner approach.
PLC-025.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No measurable effect of idle services on game performance has been shown.
rehber.adimlar: Not recommended.
If NVDisplay.ContainerLocalSystem is turned off, the NVIDIA Control Panel does not open.
PLC-025.rehber.kontrol: Get-Service -Name NvContainerLocalSystem, NVDisplay.ContainerLocalSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Status, StartType

PLC-026.ad: Turning on Triple Buffering for DirectX games
PLC-026.ne_ise_yarar: According to NVIDIA, this setting only affects OpenGL applications.
artilar: Can prevent FPS from halving in an OpenGL + V-Sync scenario
eksiler: One extra frame of latency in OpenGL
PLC-026.gerceklik.aciklama: A setting wrongly applied to DirectX games.
notlar: This driver setting only affects OpenGL games; turning it on has no effect in DirectX games.
rehber.adimlar: No effect (in DX games).
PLC-026.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > Triple buffering.

PLC-027.ad: 'The Ultimate Performance plan multiplies FPS on laptops'
PLC-027.ne_ise_yarar: Using a plan designed for desktop workstations on a laptop.
artilar: A small responsiveness improvement on some systems
eksiler: Higher heat can cause thermal throttling and wipe out the gain
Battery life drops clearly
On a laptop, the real power limits are set by OEM software/the EC
dokunmamali: Laptop users
notlar: If needed, creates and activates a copy of Windows' 'Ultimate Performance' plan; restoring brings back the previous plan and deletes the created copy.
PLC-027.gerceklik.aciklama: An exaggerated claim for laptops; for the desktop context see PWR-001.
PLC-027.performans_etkisi.gerekce: It does not change power limits, so the gain in GPU-limited laptop games is small; it can be negative with thermal throttling.
rehber.adimlar: On a laptop, use the Windows Power mode (PWR-002) and the OEM performance mode (PWR-006) instead of the power plan.

PLC-028.ad: 'Turn off Nagle and ping drops in every game'
PLC-028.ne_ise_yarar: A generalized claim: that a TCP setting lowers ping in all games.
artilar: Only in games that use TCP and do not turn off Nagle themselves
eksiler: Most modern competitive games (CS2, Valorant, Apex, Fortnite, Overwatch, Killer Instinct, etc.) use UDP; a TCP setting does not affect them
The 'ping' shown on screen is determined by server distance and routing
PLC-028.bilgi.neden: A situational setting presented as a universal benefit.
PLC-028.bilgi.yapilamaz_nedeni: It is the same as the Nagle setting in the Internet/Network menu (NET-006); you can turn it on/off there.
PLC-028.gerceklik.aciklama: A situational setting presented as a universal benefit.
PLC-028.performans_etkisi.gerekce: By design, no effect in UDP-based games.

PLC-029.ne_ise_yarar: Overwrites the page file with zeros at shutdown. This is a security feature (prevents old memory data on the disk from being read while the PC is off).
artilar: Security in physical access scenarios
eksiler: Shutdown takes longer (minutes with large page files)
notlar: Shutdown time may get noticeably longer.
PLC-029.gerceklik.aciklama: A security setting mistaken for a performance setting.
PLC-029.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Does not change the performance of the next session.
rehber.adimlar: Unnecessary for performance.

GPU-020.ad: G-SYNC scope: full screen only / full screen and windowed
GPU-020.ne_ise_yarar: Sets in which window modes G-SYNC (variable refresh rate) works. Many games now run in borderless windowed mode, so unless 'full screen and windowed' is chosen G-SYNC may not kick in for them.
artilar: A tear-free, low-latency picture in borderless windowed games too
eksiler: Some desktop programs (video players, browsers) may flicker or show brightness fluctuation
dokunmamali: Anyone without a G-SYNC / G-SYNC Compatible monitor (the setting has no effect)
notlar: G-SYNC itself is turned on for the monitor in NVIDIA Control Panel > Set up G-SYNC; this setting only chooses in which window modes it works.
GPU-020.gerceklik.aciklama: A setting documented in NVIDIA's driver settings header (NvApiDriverSettings.h: VRR_MODE).
GPU-020.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Does not change FPS; on a G-SYNC monitor it prevents tearing and V-Sync latency in windowed games.
rehber.adimlar: For G-SYNC to work in games running in borderless windowed mode: Full screen and windowed.
GPU-020.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA Control Panel > Set up G-SYNC > 'Enable for full screen mode' / 'Enable for windowed and full screen mode'.

PLC-030.ad: Turning off 8.3 short file names 'speeds up games'
PLC-030.ne_ise_yarar: Decides whether NTFS creates old DOS-compatible short names (like PROGRA~1) for new files.
artilar: File creation can get slightly faster in folders with very many files
eksiler: Very old installers and scripts that rely on short names can break
PLC-030.gerceklik.aciklama: A file system setting spread as an FPS setting.
PLC-030.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only affects name generation when new files are created; unrelated to rendering game frames.
rehber.adimlar: Unnecessary for game performance.

PLC-031.ad: Turning off file 'last access time' updates (NtfsDisableLastAccessUpdate)
PLC-031.ne_ise_yarar: Decides whether NTFS writes the 'last access' time each time a file is read.
artilar: Slightly fewer disk writes in jobs that scan many small files
eksiler: Backup and storage tools that look at the last access time may see wrong data
PLC-031.gerceklik.aciklama: An old Windows-era disk setting repeated as a gaming setting.
PLC-031.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Since Windows 10 1803 this value is already managed by Windows; games read their files once while loading, so frame rate is not affected.
rehber.adimlar: Unnecessary for game performance.

PLC-032.ne_ise_yarar: A value that Windows 2000 documentation describes as the most memory that can be locked for I/O operations.
artilar: None (for games)
eksiler: Leaves a value with no effect in the registry
PLC-032.gerceklik.aciklama: A value left over from XP-era tuning guides.
PLC-032.performans_etkisi.gerekce: A setting from the Windows XP era; no official source showing modern Windows still reads it, and no measured FPS effect, was found.
rehber.adimlar: Unnecessary for game performance.

PLC-033.ad: Writing the CPU's L2 cache size to SecondLevelDataCache
PLC-033.ne_ise_yarar: Tells Windows the processor's L2 cache size by hand.
artilar: None (for games)
eksiler: Next to none; leaves a value with no effect
PLC-033.gerceklik.aciklama: A value that only meant something on very old processors.
PLC-033.performans_etkisi.gerekce: According to Microsoft's documentation the value is only used when the hardware layer (HAL) cannot detect the L2 size; on today's processors the size is detected anyway.
rehber.adimlar: Unnecessary for game performance.

PLC-034.ad: 'Speeding up the network' with MaxUserPort / TcpTimedWaitDelay
PLC-034.ne_ise_yarar: Changes how many ports outgoing connections can use and how long closed connections wait.
artilar: Prevents port exhaustion on servers that open thousands of connections per second
eksiler: A shorter wait raises the chance of late packets mixing into a new connection
PLC-034.varsayilan: Values not present (dynamic ports 49152–65535, TIME_WAIT 120 s).
PLC-034.gerceklik.aciklama: A server setting applied to a gaming PC.
PLC-034.performans_etkisi.gerekce: A game uses a few connections; port exhaustion does not happen on a gaming PC, so ping and frame rate are not affected.
rehber.adimlar: Unnecessary for game performance.

PLC-035.ne_ise_yarar: Sets how many routers a sent packet can pass through (its lifetime).
artilar: None (for games)
eksiler: Packets to very distant servers may be dropped on the way (if the value is made very small)
PLC-035.gerceklik.aciklama: A packet lifetime limit mistaken for a latency setting.
PLC-035.performans_etkisi.gerekce: TTL is only an upper limit on how many hops a packet can take; it does not change packet speed or route.
rehber.adimlar: Unnecessary for game performance.

SYS-016.ne_ise_yarar: Decides whether Windows shows a confirmation window when a program asks for administrator rights, and whether it dims the screen.
artilar: Fewer confirmation windows (at lower levels)
Always notify: also asks on settings changes
eksiler: At lower levels, malicious programs can get administrator rights without being noticed
dokunmamali: People who share the computer with others
People who often download programs

SYS-016.gerceklik.aciklama: Not a performance setting; a convenience/security trade-off.
SYS-016.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only changes when the confirmation window appears; does not affect game performance.
rehber.adimlar: From the level picker in the app, or Control Panel > User Accounts > Change User Account Control settings.
SYS-016.rehber.geri_alma: 'Restore' on the Changes page, or the 'Default' level.

SYS-017.ad: Turning off Windows Defender real-time protection
SYS-017.ne_ise_yarar: Stops Defender from scanning files as they are opened and downloaded. Defender services, definition updates and manual scans stay as they are.
artilar: Removes scanning delay in file-heavy jobs such as installs, game loading and builds
eksiler: Malware is not blocked when it is opened
Windows may turn protection back on by itself after a while or after a restart
dokunmamali: Everyone without another antivirus
People who download files and mods from the internet
SYS-017.gerceklik.aciklama: Real in file-heavy jobs but mostly unnoticeable in game; the security cost is high.
SYS-017.performans_etkisi.gerekce: While a game runs, the effect on FPS is usually within measurement error; the difference shows in loading and file copying.
rehber.adimlar: First Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings > Tamper Protection: Off. Then 'Turn off real-time protection' in the app.

GPU-021.ne_ise_yarar: Turns on the driver-side quality upscaling of NVIDIA Image Scaling (NIS), which renders the game at a lower resolution and scales it to the screen resolution. It is a way to raise FPS when the graphics card is the limit; the picture can be a little softer than native resolution.
artilar: Can raise the frame rate when the graphics card is the limit
Works in games without DLSS support
eksiler: Image quality is lower than native resolution
This driver setting may not be enough on its own; Image Scaling must also be on in the NVIDIA app
dokunmamali: Anyone already getting smooth frame rates at native resolution
Anyone using the game's own DLSS/FSR upscaling (the two are not used together)
notlar: For it to work in a game, Image Scaling must also be on in the NVIDIA app; the real effect of the upscaling was not measured in this app.
GPU-021.gerceklik.aciklama: The setting is listed in NVIDIA Profile Inspector's setting dictionary (0x10444444, 'NVIDIA Image Scaling - Quality Upscaling'); it has no entry in the official header file. The app verified that the driver accepts the value; the effect in games was not measured.
GPU-021.performans_etkisi.gerekce: FPS only rises when the graphics card is the limit and a lower resolution is chosen; no effect when the CPU is the limit. Not measured in this app.
rehber.adimlar: Driver setting: On. For NIS to work in a game, Image Scaling must also be on in the NVIDIA app.
GPU-021.rehber.kontrol: NVIDIA app / Control Panel > Image Scaling (NIS).

GPU-022.ad: Block the NVIDIA overlay from attaching to games
GPU-022.ne_ise_yarar: At driver level, prohibits the NVIDIA app's in-game overlay (Alt+Z panel, Instant Replay, game filters) from attaching to DirectX games. For people who do not use the overlay, it keeps one background component away from the game.
artilar: No extra overlay attaches to the game
May reduce the chance of conflicts in games that clash with the overlay, including some anti-cheat warnings
eksiler: Instant Replay, the in-game panel and NVIDIA game filters stop working
dokunmamali: Anyone who uses Instant Replay or the in-game NVIDIA panel
notlar: Instant Replay and the in-game NVIDIA panel do not work while this setting is on.
GPU-022.gerceklik.aciklama: The setting is listed in NVIDIA Profile Inspector's setting dictionary (0x90DE9159, 'Driver - NVIDIA App Overlay Shim Prohibition'); there is no official documentation. Writing needs administrator rights (the driver refused it without them); as administrator it was written, read back and reverted. That the overlay is really disabled and the FPS effect were not measured.
GPU-022.performans_etkisi.gerekce: A very small load reduction is expected with the overlay off; not measured in this app.
rehber.adimlar: Driver setting: prohibit the NVIDIA app overlay from attaching to DirectX games.
GPU-022.rehber.geri_alma: Off (the overlay is allowed; driver default).

SYS-018.ad: Long file path support (lift the 260-character limit)
SYS-018.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No effect on FPS or speed; it is only a compatibility setting.
SYS-018.gerceklik.aciklama: A setting documented by Microsoft (Maximum Path Length Limitation). Its effect depends on the program declaring long path support.
SYS-018.ne_ise_yarar: Lifts Windows' 260-character file path limit for programs that declare long path support. Prevents 'path too long' errors in deep folder structures (software development, game mods, archives).
artilar: Fewer 'path too long' errors in deep folders
May be needed by developer tools and some game mod managers
eksiler: Only programs that declare long path support (manifest) benefit; older programs can still fail
dokunmamali: Anyone who works with short paths and never sees this error (turning it on gives no benefit)
notlar: Long path support only applies to programs that declare it (manifest); the setting is fully effective after a restart.
rehber.adimlar: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem' -Name LongPathsEnabled -Type DWord -Value 1

SYS-019.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only changes the content of the crash screen; no effect on performance.
SYS-019.gerceklik.aciklama: The behavior is real, but in this app it rests on a single tool list (CTT WinUtil); there is no verified official documentation and it was not tested by causing a blue screen.
SYS-019.ne_ise_yarar: On a blue screen (crash), also shows driver/module information next to the error code and removes the sad-face icon. It makes it easier to see which file the error came from when troubleshooting.
artilar: The source of the error is visible on screen at crash time
Gives more clues for tech support or forums
eksiler: Only noticeable when a blue screen happens; no effect in normal use
dokunmamali: Anyone who never sees blue screens (no visible benefit)
notlar: Only visible on a blue screen; not tested in this app by causing a blue screen.
rehber.adimlar: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl' -Name DisplayParameters -Type DWord -Value 1; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl' -Name DisableEmoticon -Type DWord -Value 1
SYS-019.rehber.geri_alma: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl' -Name DisplayParameters -Type DWord -Value 0; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl' -Name DisableEmoticon -Type DWord -Value 0
SYS-019.sade_ad: Showing details on the blue screen

SYS-020.ad: Turn off publishing and uploading activity history
SYS-020.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No FPS effect expected; the main purpose is privacy. Not measured.
SYS-020.gerceklik.aciklama: Microsoft-documented group policy settings (Publish/Upload User Activities); the mechanism is real and the performance effect is small.
SYS-020.ne_ise_yarar: Stops Windows from publishing the things you do (opened documents, sites) as activity history and uploading them to your Microsoft account. Does not affect clipboard history.
artilar: Activity data is not uploaded to your Microsoft account
A small amount of background activity and a privacy concern go away
eksiler: Cross-device activity continuation in Timeline (Win+Tab) stops working
dokunmamali: Anyone who uses cross-device activity history
notlar: This is a system policy; cross-device activity continuation in Timeline does not work. Clipboard history is not affected.
SYS-020.varsayilan: Not defined (Windows uses its own setting).
rehber.adimlar: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name PublishUserActivities -Type DWord -Value 0; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name UploadUserActivities -Type DWord -Value 0

SYS-021.ad: Block downloading device metadata from the internet
SYS-021.performans_etkisi.gerekce: Only blocks a background download when a device is plugged in; no effect on game performance.
SYS-021.gerceklik.aciklama: The setting is a real Windows policy; but the 'prevents extra software installs' effect rests in this app on a single tool list (CTT WinUtil) and was not tested.
SYS-021.ne_ise_yarar: When a new device (monitor, mouse, printer) is plugged in, stops Windows from downloading the device icon and information from the internet. May also reduce extra manufacturer software installing itself with the device.
artilar: No background download when a device is plugged in
Less extra software arriving with devices
eksiler: Devices may show with a generic icon in Windows
Devices that expect the manufacturer's Store app to install itself (headsets, mouse software) may not get it
dokunmamali: Anyone who wants device software through Windows Update/Store
notlar: This is a system policy; device icons and some device software do not arrive automatically from the internet.
SYS-021.varsayilan: Not defined (Windows may fetch metadata from the internet).
rehber.adimlar: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Device Metadata' -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Device Metadata' -Name PreventDeviceMetadataFromNetwork -Type DWord -Value 1

SYS-022.ne_ise_yarar: Makes the RAM run at the speed printed on its box. With it off, the module often runs at a much slower base speed.
artilar: RAM runs at its advertised speed
Noticeable in memory-sensitive games and on integrated graphics
eksiler: Some motherboard/CPU/RAM combinations become unstable (blue screens, no boot)
The profile can push the CPU's memory controller beyond its normal limit
dokunmamali: Users with stability problems or who care about warranty (update the BIOS first)
SYS-022.varsayilan: Off on most motherboards (RAM runs at its base speed).
SYS-022.gerceklik.aciklama: Often recommended in forums and videos; the gain depends on the game and CPU and was not measured for this project.
SYS-022.performans_etkisi.gerekce: The gain varies with the game and CPU; not measured for this project.
rehber.adimlar: Restart the computer and enter the BIOS (usually Del or F2 at startup).
In the memory/OC section, choose the XMP (Intel) or EXPO/DOCP (AMD) profile.
Save and exit (F10). If it will not boot, reset the BIOS; if it is unstable, turn the profile off.
SYS-022.rehber.geri_alma: Set XMP/EXPO to Disabled/Auto in the BIOS.
SYS-022.rehber.kontrol: PowerShell: Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory | Select-Object Speed, ConfiguredClockSpeed. Speed is the module's advertised speed, ConfiguredClockSpeed is the speed it runs at now.
SYS-022.sade_ad: Running RAM at its advertised speed (XMP/EXPO)

SYS-023.ad: Do not turn off Secure Boot (for anti-cheat)
SYS-023.ne_ise_yarar: With Secure Boot on, only signed boot software runs. Some anti-cheats, such as Valorant (Vanguard) and Fortnite, may require it to be on.
artilar: Anti-cheat games do not show a 'Secure Boot required' error
Protection against tampering with the boot chain
eksiler: Can be restrictive for unsigned drivers or a second operating system
dokunmamali: People who play anti-cheat games (such as Valorant, Fortnite): do not turn it off
SYS-023.gerceklik.aciklama: Which game asks for Secure Boot depends on the game and version; confirm on the game's own support page. Not measured for this project.
SYS-023.performans_etkisi.gerekce: No performance gain from turning Secure Boot off was measured; in some games it can block play.
rehber.adimlar: First check msinfo32 > the 'Secure Boot State' line.
If a game such as Valorant or Fortnite asks for it and it is Off, turn Secure Boot on in the BIOS (Boot/Security section).
You do not need to turn it off for performance; if you play anti-cheat games, leave it on.
SYS-023.rehber.geri_alma: Set Secure Boot to Disabled in the BIOS.
SYS-023.rehber.kontrol: msinfo32 > System Summary > 'Secure Boot State' (On/Off). PowerShell: Confirm-SecureBootUEFI (administrator).
